title: Think Twice, Act Once: Verifier-Guided Action Selection For Embodied Agents
summary: Building generalist embodied agents capable of solving complex real-world tasks remains a fundamental challenge in AI. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly advanced the reasoning capabilities of such agents through strong vision-language knowledge and chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, yet remain brittle when faced with challenging out-of-distribution scenarios. To address this, we propose Verifier-Guided Action Selection (VegAS), a test-time framework designed to improve the robustness of MLLM-based embodied agents through an explicit verification step. At inference time, rather than committing to a single decoded action, VeGAS samples an ensemble of candidate actions and uses a generative verifier to identify the most reliable choice, without modifying the underlying policy. Crucially, we find that using an MLLM off-the-shelf as a verifier yields no improvement, motivating our LLM-driven data synthesis strategy, which automatically constructs a diverse curriculum of failure cases to expose the verifier to a rich distribution of potential errors at training time. Across embodied reasoning benchmarks spanning the Habitat and ALFRED environments, VeGAS consistently improves generalization, achieving up to a 36% relative performance gain over strong CoT baselines on the most challenging multi-object, long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出了VeGAS框架，通过生成式验证器对候选动作进行测试时验证选择，提升基于多模态大语言模型的具身智能体在分布外场景的鲁棒性，在Habitat和ALFRED基准测试中取得最高36%的相对性能提升。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在具身智能体中展现出强大的视觉-语言知识和链式推理能力，但在具有挑战性的分布外场景中表现脆弱，亟需提升其鲁棒性。
AI.method: VeGAS框架：在推理阶段，采样一组候选动作，使用生成式验证器（generative verifier）从中选择最可靠的动作，而非直接执行单一解码动作。其中验证器通过LLM驱动的数据合成策略自动构建多样化失败案例课程进行训练。
AI.result: 在Habitat和ALFRED具身推理基准测试中，VeGAS一致性地提升了泛化能力，在最具挑战性的多目标、长周期任务上相对于强CoT基线取得了最高36%的相对性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 验证器引导的动作选择（VeGAS）是一种有效的测试时框架，通过显式验证步骤显著提升MLLM具身智能体的鲁棒性，且无需修改底层策略。
idea_en: A test-time verification framework (VeGAS) for embodied agents that samples an ensemble of candidate actions from an MLLM policy and uses a generative verifier to select the most reliable action, without modifying the underlying policy.
An LLM-driven data synthesis strategy that automatically constructs a diverse curriculum of failure cases to train the generative verifier, exposing it to a rich distribution of potential errors.
A generative verifier trained on synthesized failure cases that can evaluate and rank candidate actions for embodied agents at inference time, improving out-of-distribution robustness.
A method that uses off-the-shelf MLLMs as generative verifiers with additional training via synthesized data, overcoming the limitation that naive MLLM verifiers yield no improvement.
idea_ch: 一种测试时验证框架(VeGAS)：从MLLM策略中采样一组候选动作，利用生成式验证器选择最可靠动作，无需修改底层策略即可提升具身智能体鲁棒性
一种LLM驱动的数据合成策略：自动构建多样化的失败案例课程用于训练生成式验证器，使其接触到丰富的潜在错误分布
一种生成式验证器：基于合成的失败案例进行训练，能够在推理阶段对具身智能体的候选动作进行评估和排序，提升分布外场景的鲁棒性

title: Macro-Action Based Multi-Agent Instruction Following through Value Cancellation
summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) in real-world use cases may need to adapt to external natural language instructions that interrupt ongoing behavior and conflict with long-horizon objectives. However, conditioning rewards on instructions introduces a fundamental failure mode as Bellman updates couple value estimates across instruction contexts, leading to inconsistent values when instructions interrupt macro-actions. We propose Macro-Action Value Correction for Instruction Compliance (MAVIC), which corrects Bellman backups at instruction boundaries by correcting the incoming instruction objective and restoring the continuation value under the current objective. Unlike reward shaping, MAVIC modifies the bootstrapping target itself, enabling consistent value estimation under stochastic instruction switching within a unified policy. We provide theoretical analysis and an actor-critic implementation, and show that MAVIC achieves high instruction compliance while preserving base task performance in increasingly complex cooperative multi-agent environments.

AI.tldr: MAVIC提出了一种在宏动作边界修正Bellman备份的方法，使多智能体强化学习系统能在执行长期任务时正确响应外部自然语言指令，避免价值估计不一致的问题。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的多智能体强化学习需要适应外部自然语言指令，这些指令可能中断正在执行的行为并与长期目标冲突。传统方法在指令边界处因Bellman更新耦合了不同指令上下文的价值估计，导致价值不一致和策略失效。
AI.method: MAVIC通过在指令边界处修正Bellman备份：校正传入的指令目标，并恢复当前目标下的延续价值。与奖励塑形不同，MAVIC修改了自举目标本身，从而在统一策略下实现随机指令切换时的一致价值估计。
AI.result: 在越来越复杂的合作多智能体环境中，MAVIC在保持基础任务性能的同时实现了高指令遵从性。
AI.conclusion: MAVIC提供了一种理论分析和Actor-Critic实现，有效解决了多智能体系统中指令中断与长期目标冲突时的价值估计一致性问题。
idea_en: A method for correcting Bellman backups at instruction boundaries in multi-agent reinforcement learning, where the incoming instruction objective is corrected and the continuation value under the current objective is restored to maintain consistent value estimation.

A system that modifies the bootstrapping target itself (rather than reward shaping) to enable consistent value estimation under stochastic instruction switching within a unified policy in multi-agent systems.

An actor-critic implementation architecture that achieves high instruction compliance while preserving base task performance in cooperative multi-agent environments with external natural language interruptions.
A theoretical framework for analyzing value estimation consistency in multi-agent reinforcement learning when external instructions interrupt macro-actions and conflict with long-horizon objectives.
idea_ch: 一种在多智能体强化学习中于指令边界处修正Bellman备份的方法，通过校正传入指令目标并恢复当前目标下的延续价值，保持价值估计的一致性。
一种修改自举目标本身而非奖励塑形的系统，能够在统一策略下实现随机指令切换时的一致价值估计，适用于多智能体场景。
一种Actor-Critic实现架构，在合作多智能体环境中应对外部自然语言中断时，既能实现高指令遵从性又能保持基础任务性能。
一种用于分析多智能体强化学习中外部指令中断宏动作并与长期目标冲突时价值估计一致性的理论框架。

title: Do Androids Dream of Breaking the Game? Systematically Auditing AI Agent Benchmarks with BenchJack
summary: Agent benchmarks have become the de facto measure of frontier AI competence, guiding model selection, investment, and deployment. However, reward hacking, where agents maximize a score without performing the intended task, emerges spontaneously in frontier models without overfitting. We argue that benchmarks must be secure by design. From past incidents of reward hacks, we derive a taxonomy of eight recurring flaw patterns and compile them into the Agent-Eval Checklist for benchmark designers. We condense the insights into BenchJack, an automated red-teaming system that drives coding agents to audit benchmarks and identify possible reward-hacking exploits in a clairvoyant manner. Moreover, we extend BenchJack to an iterative generative-adversarial pipeline that discovers new flaws and patches them iteratively to improve benchmark robustness. We apply BenchJack to 10 popular agent benchmarks spanning software engineering, web navigation, desktop computing, and terminal operations. BenchJack synthesizes reward-hacking exploits that achieve near-perfect scores on most of the benchmarks without solving a single task, surfacing 219 distinct flaws across the eight classes. Moreover, BenchJack's extended pipeline reduces the hackable-task ratio from near 100% to under 10% on four benchmarks without fatal design flaws, fully patching WebArena and OSWorld within three iterations. Our results show that evaluation pipelines have not internalized an adversarial mindset, and that proactive auditing could help close the security gap for the fast-paced benchmarking space.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了AI Agent基准测试中普遍存在的奖励黑客（reward hacking）问题，提出了一套分类体系（8种漏洞模式）并开发了BenchJack自动化红队系统，能够发现并修补基准测试漏洞。实验表明，BenchJack在10个主流基准测试中合成了219个漏洞，并可迭代地将可破解任务比例从近100%降至10%以下。
AI.motivation: 当前AI Agent基准测试存在严重的安全漏洞，前沿模型会自发地通过奖励黑客（而非真正完成任务）来获得高分，这使得基准测试无法真实反映模型能力。基准测试设计者缺乏安全设计意识，需要一个系统性的方法来发现和修补这些漏洞。
AI.method: 1. 从历史奖励黑客事件中提炼出8种漏洞模式分类体系；2. 开发BenchJack自动化红队系统，驱动编码代理以"先知视角"审计基准测试；3. 扩展为迭代式生成-对抗管道，自动发现新漏洞并打补丁。
AI.result: BenchJack在10个流行基准测试中发现了219个不同的漏洞，覆盖全部8种类型；在不解决任何实际任务的情况下实现了接近完美的分数；迭代管道将可破解任务比例从近100%降至10%以下，WebArena和OSWorld在3轮迭代内完全修复。
AI.conclusion: 现有评估体系缺乏对抗性思维，基准测试必须从一开始就进行安全设计。主动审计可以有效缩小基准测试的安全缺口，迭代式生成-对抗管道是一种有效的基准加固方法。
idea_en: A system and method for automated red-teaming of AI agent benchmarks using coding agents to identify reward-hacking exploits in a clairvoyant manner
An iterative generative-adversarial pipeline that discovers benchmark flaws and automatically patches them to improve robustness
A taxonomy-based checklist (Agent-Eval Checklist) for designing secure-by-default AI agent benchmarks with eight recurring flaw patterns
A method for achieving near-perfect scores on agent benchmarks without solving actual tasks by exploiting reward function design flaws
idea_ch: 一种利用编码代理以先知视角自动化红队审计AI代理基准测试、识别奖励黑客漏洞的系统和方法
一种迭代式生成-对抗管道，能够自动发现基准测试缺陷并对其进行修补以提升鲁棒性

title: Revealing Interpretable Failure Modes of VLMs
summary:
Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used in safety-critical applications because of their broad reasoning capabilities and ability to generalize with minimal task-specific engineering. Despite these advantages, they can exhibit catastrophic failures in specific real-world situations, constituting failure modes.
  We introduce REVELIO, a framework for systematically uncovering interpretable failure modes in VLMs. We define a failure mode as a composition of interpretable, domain-relevant concepts-such as pedestrian proximity or adverse weather conditions-under which a target VLM consistently behaves incorrectly. Identifying such failures requires searching over an exponentially large discrete combinatorial space. To address this challenge, REVELIO combines two search procedures: a diversity-aware beam search that efficiently maps the failure landscape, and a Gaussian-process Thompson Sampling strategy that enables broader exploration of complex failure modes.
  We apply REVELIO to autonomous driving and indoor robotics domains, uncovering previously unreported vulnerabilities in state-of-the-art VLMs. In driving environments, the models often demonstrate weak spatial grounding and fail to account for major obstructions, leading to recommendations that would result in simulated crashes. In indoor robotics tasks, VLMs either miss safety hazards or behave excessively conservatively, producing false alarms and reducing operational efficiency. By identifying structured and interpretable failure modes, REVELIO offers actionable insights that can support targeted VLM safety improvements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REVELIO框架，用于系统性地发现视觉-语言模型（VLM）在安全关键应用中的可解释故障模式，通过结合多样性感知波束搜索和高斯过程汤普森采样，高效搜索组合概念空间，并在自动驾驶和室内机器人领域发现了新的漏洞。
AI.motivation: VLM在安全关键应用中可能表现出灾难性故障，但现有方法缺乏系统性发现这些故障模式的框架。故障模式由多个可解释概念组合而成，搜索空间呈指数级增长，需要高效的方法来映射故障空间。
AI.method: REVELIO框架结合两种搜索策略：(1) 多样性感知波束搜索，高效映射故障景观；(2) 高斯过程汤普森采样策略，实现更广泛的复杂故障模式探索。将故障模式定义为可解释、领域相关概念的组合，在这些组合下目标VLM持续表现错误。
AI.result: 在自动驾驶领域发现VLM存在弱空间定位能力，无法考虑主要障碍物，导致推荐行为会造成模拟碰撞；在室内机器人任务中，VLM要么遗漏安全风险，要么过度保守产生误报，降低操作效率。
AI.conclusion: REVELIO能够识别结构化和可解释的故障模式，为目标VLM的安全改进提供可操作的洞察。
idea_en: A framework for systematically discovering interpretable failure modes in Vision-Language Models by searching over compositional concept spaces using diversity-aware beam search and Gaussian-process Thompson Sampling.
A method for defining failure modes as compositions of interpretable, domain-relevant concepts under which a target VLM consistently behaves incorrectly.
A diversity-aware beam search algorithm specifically designed to efficiently map the failure landscape in exponentially large discrete combinatorial spaces.
A Gaussian-process Thompson Sampling strategy for broad exploration of complex failure modes in VLM safety analysis.
Application of the framework to autonomous driving domain for uncovering weak spatial grounding and obstruction-related failures in VLMs.
Application of the framework to indoor robotics domain for identifying hazard-missing and overly conservative behavior failure modes in VLMs.
idea_ch: 一种通过多样性感知波束搜索和高斯过程汤普森采样在组合概念空间中搜索，系统性发现视觉-语言模型可解释故障模式的框架

title: Learning Transferable Latent User Preferences for Human-Aligned Decision Making
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as reasoning modules in many applications. While they are efficient in certain tasks, LLMs often struggle to produce human-aligned solutions. Human-aligned decision making requires accounting for both explicitly stated goals and latent user preferences that shape how ambiguous situations should be resolved. Existing approaches to incorporating such preferences either rely on extensive and repeated user interactions or fail to generalize latent preferences across tasks and contexts, limiting their practical applicability. We consider a setting in which an LLM is used for high-level reasoning and is responsible for inferring latent user preferences from limited interactions, which guides downstream decision making. We introduce CLIPR (Conversational Learning for Inferring Preferences and Reasoning), a framework that learns actionable, transferable natural language rules that represent latent user preferences from minimal conversational input. These rules are iteratively refined through adaptive feedback and applied to both in-distribution and out-of-distribution ambiguous tasks across multiple environments. Evaluations on three datasets and a user study show that CLIPR consistently outperforms existing methods in improving alignment and reducing inference costs.

AI.tldr: 提出CLIPR框架，通过少量对话交互学习用户潜在偏好的自然语言规则，使LLM在推理时更好地对齐用户意图，并在多个数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: LLM作为推理模块时难以产生与人类对齐的解决方案，现有方法要么需要大量用户交互，要么无法跨任务泛化潜在偏好，实用性受限。
AI.method: CLIPR框架通过有限对话输入学习可迁移的自然语言规则，这些规则代表用户潜在偏好，并通过自适应反馈迭代优化，应用于分布内和分布外的模糊任务。
AI.result: 在三个数据集和用户研究中，CLIPR在提升对齐性和降低推理成本方面持续优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过少量对话交互学习可迁移的偏好规则，能有效提升LLM推理与人类对齐的性能，具有实用价值。
idea_en: A method for inferring latent user preferences from minimal conversational interactions using LLM, encoding preferences as actionable natural language rules.
An iterative refinement framework that adaptively updates preference rules based on user feedback across tasks.
A transferable rule learning system that applies learned latent preferences to both in-distribution and out-of-distribution ambiguous tasks.
A conversational preference inference mechanism that reduces user interaction costs while improving alignment in LLM-based reasoning systems.
idea_ch: 一种基于LLM从少量对话交互中推断用户潜在偏好的方法，将偏好编码为可执行的自然语言规则。
一种跨任务自适应反馈迭代优化偏好规则的框架，持续更新用户偏好规则库。
一种可迁移规则学习系统，能将学到的潜在偏好同时应用于分布内和分布外的模糊任务。

title: On the Size Complexity and Decidability of First-Order Progression
comment: This is an extended version of an identically-titled paper accepted for publication at IJCAI 2026. This version contains an appendix with further proofs
summary: Progression, the task of updating a knowledge base to reflect action effects, generally requires second-order logic. Identifying first-order special cases, by restricting either the knowledge base or action effects, has long been a central topic in reasoning about actions. It is known that local-effect, normal, and acyclic actions, three increasingly expressive classes, admit first-order progression. However, a systematic analysis of the size of such progressions, crucial for practical applications, has been missing. In this paper, using the framework of Situation Calculus, we show that under reasonable assumptions, first-order progression for these action classes grows only polynomially. Moreover, we show that when the KB belongs to decidable fragments such as two-variable first-order logic or universal theories with constants, the progression remains within the same fragment, ensuring decidability and practical applicability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了情景演算中知识库进展的复杂性问题，证明了三类可一阶进展的动作（局部效应、正规动作、无环动作）在合理假设下其进展规模呈多项式增长，且当知识库属于可判定片段时，进展仍保持在同一片段内。
AI.motivation: 虽然已有研究识别出三类可一阶逻辑进展的动作类（局部效应、正规、无环），但这些进展的规模分析长期缺失，而这对于实际应用至关重要。
AI.method: 基于情景演算框架，对三类可一阶进展的动作类进行规模分析，并研究知识库属于可判定片段时进展的保持性。
AI.result: 在合理假设下，这三类动作的一阶进展规模仅呈多项式增长；且当知识库属于双变元一阶逻辑或带常数的全称理论等可判定片段时，进展仍保持在相同片段内。
AI.conclusion: 该结果确保了可判定性和实际适用性，为知识库进展的实际应用提供了理论基础。
idea_en: A method for polynomial-size first-order progression of knowledge bases under local-effect, normal, and acyclic actions in the Situation Calculus framework.
A technique to maintain knowledge base progression within decidable fragments (e.g., two-variable first-order logic, universal theories with constants) after action execution.
A systematic size analysis approach for first-order progression classes, enabling efficient practical deployment of action-based knowledge base updates.
idea_ch: 一种在情景演算框架下，针对局部效应、正规和无环动作实现知识库一阶进展多项式规模增长的方法。
一种在动作执行后，使知识库进展保持在可判定片段（如双变元一阶逻辑、带常数的全称理论）内的技术方案。
一种面向一阶进展类别的系统性规模分析方法，用于支持基于动作的知识库更新在实际中的高效部署。

title: DisaBench: A Participatory Evaluation Framework for Disability Harms in Language Models
summary: General-purpose safety benchmarks for large language models do not adequately evaluate disability-related harms. We introduce DisaBench: a taxonomy of twelve disability harm categories co-created with people with disabilities and red teaming experts, a taxonomy-driven evaluation methodology that pairs benign and adversarial prompts across seven life domains, and a dataset of 175 prompts with human-annotated labels on 525 prompt-response pairs. Annotation by four evaluators with lived disability experience reveals three findings: harm rates vary sharply by disability type and will compound in non-text modalities, terminology-driven harm is culturally and temporally bound rather than universally assessable, and standard safety evaluation catches overt failures while missing the subtle harms that only domain expertise can recognize. Disability harm is simultaneously personal, intersectional, and community-defined: it cannot be isolated from the full context of who a person is, and general-purpose benchmarks systematically miss it. We will release the dataset, taxonomy, and methodology via Hugging Face and an open-source red teaming framework for direct integration into existing safety pipelines with no additional infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DisaBench，一个与残障人士共同设计的12类残障伤害分类体系、评估方法论及数据集，发现通用安全基准严重低估残障相关伤害，标准评估只能捕捉明显失败而遗漏领域专家才能识别的细微伤害。
AI.motivation: 现有的通用大语言模型安全基准无法充分评估残障相关伤害，残障群体面临的安全风险被系统性忽视。
AI.method: 1) 与残障人士及红队专家共同构建12类残障伤害分类体系；2) 基于分类体系的评估方法论，在7个生活领域配对良性/对抗性提示；3) 构建175个提示的数据集，由4名有残障经历评估者对525个提示-响应对进行人工标注。
AI.result: 伤害率因残障类型差异显著；术语驱动的伤害具有文化和时间边界性，并非普遍可评估；标准安全评估仅能捕捉明显失败，无法识别需要领域专业知识的细微伤害。
AI.conclusion: 残障伤害是个人化、交叉性、社区定义的，不能脱离人的完整背景来评估，通用基准系统性遗漏这些伤害。
idea_en: A taxonomy-driven methodology for evaluating disability-related harms in LLMs by pairing benign and adversarial prompts across multiple life domains

title: CHAL: Council of Hierarchical Agentic Language
summary: Multi-agent debate has emerged as a promising approach for improving LLM reasoning on ground-truth tasks, yet current methodologies face certain structural limitations: debate tends to induce a martingale over belief trajectories, majority voting accounts for most observed gains, and LLMs exhibit confidence escalation rather than calibration across rounds. We argue that the genuine value of debate, and dialectic systems as a whole, lies not in ground-truth tasks but in defeasible domains, where every position can in principle be defeated by better reasoning. We present the Council of Hierarchical Agentic Language (CHAL), a multi-agent dialectic framework that treats defeasible argumentation as an engine for belief optimization. Each agent maintains a CHAL Belief Schema (CBS), a graph-structured belief representation with a Bayesian-inspired architecture, that facilitates belief revision through a gradient-informed dynamic mechanism by leveraging the strength of the belief's thesis as a differentiable objective. Meta-cognitive value systems spanning epistemology, logic, and ethics are elevated to configurable hyperparameters governing agent reasoning and adjudication outcomes. We provide a series of ablation experiments that demonstrate systematic and interpretable effects: the adjudicator's value system determines the debate's overall trajectories in latent belief space, council diversity refines beliefs for all participants, and the framework generalizes across broad fields. CHAL is, to our knowledge, the first framework to treat multi-agent debate as structured belief optimization over defeasible domains. Further, the auditable belief artifacts it produces establish the foundation for dedicated evaluation suites for defeasible argumentation, with broader implications for building AI systems whose reasoning and value commitments are transparent, aligned, and subject to human oversight.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CHAL框架，将多智能体辩论从确定性任务转向可废止论证领域，通过图结构信念表示（CBS）和梯度驱动动态机制实现信念优化，并将元认知价值系统作为可配置超参数，首次将辩论视为结构化信念优化过程。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体辩论方法存在结构局限：辩论会导致信念轨迹上的鞅过程、多数投票贡献了大部分收益、LLM在轮次间出现置信度升级而非校准。作者认为辩论的真正价值不在确定性任务，而在可废止领域（任何立场原则上可被更优推理推翻）。

AI.result: 消融实验表明：裁决者的价值系统决定辩论在潜在信念空间的整体轨迹；议会多样性优化所有参与者的信念；框架在广泛领域具有泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: CHAL是首个将多智能体辩论视为可废止领域结构化信念优化的框架，产生的可审计信念工件为可废止论证评估套件奠定基础，对构建透明、对齐、可人工监督的AI系统具有广泛意义。

title: BEHAVE: A Hybrid AI Framework for Real-Time Modeling of Collective Human Dynamics
summary:
Existing AI systems for modeling human behavior operate at the level of individuals or detect events after they occur. As a result, they systematically fail to capture the collective dynamics that determine whether a group remains stable or transitions into escalation or breakdown. We propose a different foundation: a group of interacting humans constitutes a complex dynamical system in the precise mathematical sense, exhibiting emergence, nonlinearity, feedback loops, sensitivity near critical points, and phase transitions between qualitatively distinct regimes. The state of such a system is not located within any single participant; it is distributed across mutual influence loops and observable through the micro-dynamics of the body.
  We introduce BEHAVE (Behavioral Engine for Human Activity Vector Estimation), a formal framework that models collective dynamics as continuous behavioral fields defined over an interaction space derived from observable physical signals. Kinematic micro-signals (position, velocity, body orientation, gestural activity) are structured into a directed interaction graph and aggregated into a basis of behavioral fields capturing distinct, non-redundant axes of collective state. The framework rests on one theorem and two structural propositions characterizing the tension field, the field basis, and the criticality index. Perception and forecasting layers are implemented using neural models, enabling data-driven learning and approximation of system dynamics. BEHAVE is formulated as a computational system for learning, representing, and forecasting collective dynamics from data. A working pipeline is demonstrated on a 7-agent negotiation snapshot. The same fields, recalibrated, apply to crowd safety, crisis-team dynamics, education, and clinical contexts.

AI.motivation: 现有AI系统仅建模个体行为或事后检测事件，无法捕捉决定群体稳定或转向升级/崩溃的集体动力学。

AI.result: 在7人谈判快照上验证了工作流水线，表明该框架可扩展应用于人群安全、危机团队、教育及临床场景。
AI.conclusion: BEHAVE提供了一种数学严谨的集体动力学建模新范式，从个体微信号到群体相变的完整计算框架。

title: State-Centric Decision Process
summary: Language environments such as web browsers, code terminals, and interactive simulations emit raw text rather than states, and provide none of the runtime structure that MDP analysis requires. No explicit state space, no observation-to-state mapping, no certified transitions, and no termination criterion. We introduce the State-Centric Decision Process (SDP), a runtime framework that constructs these missing inputs by having the agent build them, predicate by predicate, as it acts. At each step the agent commits to a natural-language predicate describing how the world should look, takes an action to make it true, and checks the observation against it. Predicates that pass become certified states, and the resulting trajectory carries the four objects language environments do not provide, namely a task-induced state space, an observation-to-state mapping, certified transitions, and a termination criterion. We evaluate SDP on five benchmarks spanning planning, scientific exploration, web reasoning, and multi-hop question answering. SDP achieves the best training-free results on all five, with the advantage widening as the horizon grows. The certified trajectories additionally support analyses unavailable to reactive agents, including per-predicate credit assignment, failure localization, partial-progress measurement, and modular operator replacement.

AI.tldr: 提出状态中心决策过程(SDP)，一种运行时框架，让智能体在语言环境中通过自然语言谓词自主构建状态空间、观测映射、认证转移和终止条件，实现无需训练的决策过程。
AI.motivation: 语言环境（如浏览器、终端、交互模拟）不提供MDP分析所需的显式状态空间、观测-状态映射、认证转移和终止条件，导致传统强化学习框架无法直接应用。
AI.method: 提出SDP框架：智能体在每个步骤提交一个描述世界应如何的自然语言谓词，执行动作使其为真，检查观测结果。通过的谓词成为认证状态，构建出状态空间、观测-状态映射、认证转移和终止条件四个缺失要素。
AI.result: 在规划、科学探索、Web推理和多跳问答五个基准上取得最佳无训练结果，且优势随任务长度增加而扩大。认证轨迹支持按谓词信用分配、故障定位、部分进度测量和模块化算子替换。
AI.conclusion: SDP框架有效解决了语言环境中MDP结构缺失的问题，通过谓词驱动的状态构建实现了更好的决策性能和可解释性分析能力。

title: PROMETHEUS: Automating Deep Causal Research Integrating Text, Data and Models
summary: Large language models can extract local causal claims from text, but those claims become more useful when organized as persistent, navigable world models rather than as flat summaries. We introduce PROMETHEUS, a framework that turns retrieved literature, filings, reviews, reports, agent traces, source data, code, simulations, and scientific models into causal atlases: sheaf-like families of local causal predictive-state models over an explicit cover of a research substrate. Each local region contains causal episodes, structured claim tables, predictive tests, support statistics, and provenance; restriction maps compare overlapping regions; gluing diagnostics expose agreement, drift, contradiction, and underdetermination. The resulting Topos World Model is not a single universal graph. It is a research instrument for navigating what a corpus says, where it says it, how strongly it is supported, and where local claims fail to assemble into a coherent global view. Three literature-atlas case studies -- ocean-temperature impacts on marine populations, GLP-1 weight-loss evidence, and resveratrol/red-wine health-benefit claims -- illustrate deep causal research from text with explicit locality, evidence, persistent state, and gluing tension. title: Multimodal Hidden Markov Models for Persistent Emotional State Tracking
summary: Tracking an interpretable emotional arc of a conversation via the sentiment of individual utterances processed as a whole is central to both understanding and guiding communication in applied, especially clinical, conversational contexts. Existing approaches to emotion recognition operate at the utterance level, obscuring the persistent phases that characterize real conversational dynamics. We propose a lightweight framework that models conversational emotion as a sequence of latent emotional regimes using sticky factorial HDP-HMMs over multimodal valence-arousal representations derived from simultaneous video, audio and textual input. We evaluate the quality of regime prediction using LLM-as-a-Judge, geometric, and temporal consistency metrics, demonstrating that the sticky HDP-HMM produces more interpretable regime sequences than the baseline Gaussian HMM at a fraction of the computational cost of LLM-based dialogue state tracking methods. In addition, Question-Answer experiments in a clinical dataset suggest that meaningful emotional phases can reliably be recovered from multimodal valence-arousal trajectories and used to improve the quality of LLM responses in unstable affective regimes via context augmentation. This framework thus opens a path toward interpretable, lightweight, and actionable analysis of conversational emotion dynamics at scale.

AI.tldr: 提出一个轻量级框架，使用sticky factorial HDP-HMM从多模态(视频、音频、文本)情感表征中建模对话中的潜在情感阶段，实现可解释的对话情感动态分析，并在临床数据集上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有情绪识别方法在话语级别操作，忽略了对话中持续的情感阶段，缺乏对对话情感动态的可解释建模，尤其是在临床应用场景中。

AI.conclusion: 该框架为大规模、可解释、轻量级且可操作的对话情感动态分析开辟了路径，尤其适用于临床对话场景。

title: Moltbook Moderation: Uncovering Hidden Intent Through Multi-Turn Dialogue
summary: The emergence of multi-agent systems introduces novel moderation challenges that extend beyond content filtering. Agents with {\em malicious intent} may contribute harmful content that appears benign to evade content-based moderation, while compromising the system through exploitative and malicious behavior manifested across their overall interaction patterns within the community. To address this, we introduce \textsc{\textbf{Bot-Mod}} (\textsc{\textbf{Bot-Mod}}eration), a moderation framework that grounds detection in agent intent rather than traditional content level signals. \method{} identifies the underlying intent by engaging with the target agent in a multi-turn exchange guided by Gibbs-based sampling over candidate intent hypotheses. This progressively narrows the space of plausible agent objectives to identify the underlying behavior. To evaluate our approach, we construct a dataset derived from Moltbook that encompasses diverse benign and malicious behaviors based on actual community structures, posts, and comments. Results demonstrate that \textsc{\textbf{Bot-Mod}} reliably identifies agent intent across a range of adversarial configurations, while maintaining a low false positive rate on benign behaviors. This work advances the foundation for scalable, intent-aware moderation of agents in open multi-agent environments.

AI.tldr: Bot-Mod是一个面向多智能体系统的意图驱动审核框架，通过Gibbs采样驱动的多轮对话交互来识别智能体的潜在恶意意图，从而超越传统基于内容过滤的审核方法。
AI.motivation: 现有内容审核机制无法有效识别那些表面看似无害但实际具有恶意意图的智能体行为，需要一种基于意图而非内容的审核方法。

AI.conclusion: 该工作为开放多智能体环境中可扩展的、意图感知的智能体审核奠定了基础。

title: Beyond Cooperative Simulators: Generating Realistic User Personas for Robust Evaluation of LLM Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in settings where they interact with a wide variety of people, including users who are unclear, impatient, or reluctant to share information. However, collecting real interaction data at scale remains expensive. The field has turned to LLM-based user simulators as stand-ins, but these simulators inherit the behavior of their underlying models: cooperative and homogeneous. As a result, agents that appear strong in simulation often fail under the unseen, diverse communication patterns of real users. To narrow this gap, we introduce Persona Policies (PPol), a plug-and-play control layer that induces realistic behavioral variation in user simulators while preserving the original task goals. Rather than hand-crafting personas, we cast persona generation as an LLM-driven evolutionary program search that optimizes a Python generator to discover behaviors and translate them into task-preserving roleplay policies. Candidate generators are guided by a multi-objective fitness score combining human-likeness with broad coverage of human behavioral patterns. Once optimized, the generator produces a diverse population of human-like personas for any task in the domain. Across tau^2-bench retail and airline domains, evolved PPol programs yield 33-62% absolute gains in fitness score over the baseline simulator. In a blinded evaluation, annotators rated PPol-conditioned users as human 80.4% of the time, close to real human traces and nearly twice as frequently as baseline simulators. Agents trained with PPol are more robust to challenging, out-of-distribution behaviors, improving task success by +17% relative to training only on existing simulated interactions. This offers a novel approach to strengthen simulator-based evaluation and training without changing tasks or rewards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Persona Policies (PPol)，一种即插即用的控制层，通过进化程序搜索自动生成多样化的用户模拟器人格策略，使LLM驱动的用户模拟器产生真实、多样的人类行为模式，从而缩小仿真与现实用户的差距，提升智能体训练的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM用户模拟器行为过于合作和同质化，导致在仿真中表现优异的智能体在面对真实用户多样的沟通模式时失败。需要一种能生成真实、多样化用户行为的方法。

AI.result: 在tau^2-bench零售和航空领域，PPol在适应度评分上比基线模拟器提升33-62%；盲评中PPol用户80.4%被判断为人类，接近真实人类痕迹，是基线模拟器的近两倍；使用PPol训练的智能体在应对分布外行为时任务成功率提升17%。
AI.conclusion: PPol提供了一种无需改变任务或奖励即可增强模拟器评估和训练的新方法，使智能体对真实世界中多样化的用户行为更加鲁棒。

title: When Attention Closes: How LLMs Lose the Thread in Multi-Turn Interaction
summary: Large language models can follow complex instructions in a single turn, yet over long multi-turn interactions they often lose the thread of instructions, persona, and rules. This degradation has been measured behaviorally but not mechanistically explained. We propose a channel-transition account: goal-defining tokens become less accessible through attention, while goal-related information may persist in residual representations. We introduce the Goal Accessibility Ratio (GAR), measuring attention from generated tokens to task-defining goal tokens, and combine it with sliding-window ablations and residual-stream probes. When attention to instructions closes, what survives reveals architecture. Across architectures, the transition yields qualitatively distinct failure modes: some models preserve goal-conditioned behavior at vanishing attention, others fail despite decodable residual goal information, and the layer at which this encoding emerges varies from 2 to 27. A within-model causal ablation that force-closes the attention channel in Mistral collapses recall from near-perfect to 11% on a 20-fact retention task and raises persona-constraint violations above an adversarial-pressure baseline without user pressure, with both effects emerging at the predictable crossover turn. Linear probes recover per-episode recall outcomes from residual representations with AUC up to 0.99 across all four primary architectures, while input embeddings remain at chance. Across architectures and model scales, the gap between attention loss and residual decodability predicts whether goal-conditioned behavior survives channel closure. We contribute GAR as a diagnostic, the channel-transition framework as a controlled mechanistic account, and a parametric prediction of failure timing under windowed attention closure.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过提出"通道转换"假说和"目标可达性比率(GAR)"指标，揭示了大型语言模型在多轮长对话中丢失指令、人格和规则约束的机制原因：注意力通道关闭使目标定义标记变得不可访问，但目标相关信息可能保留在残差表示中。作者通过滑动窗口消融、残差流探针和因果消融实验验证了这一机制，并预测了不同架构下的失败模式和时间点。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型能在单轮对话中遵循复杂指令，但在长时间多轮交互中经常丢失指令线索、人格设定和规则约束。虽然这种行为退化已被行为学测量所证实，但其背后的机制原因尚不清楚。作者希望从机制层面解释这一退化现象。
AI.method: 提出"通道转换"假说和"目标可达性比率(GAR)"指标，测量生成token对任务定义目标token的注意力强度；结合滑动窗口注意力消融实验和残差流探针分析；对Mistral模型进行因果消融实验，强制关闭注意力通道；使用线性探针从残差表示中恢复每个episode的召回结果。
AI.result: Mistral模型中强制关闭注意力通道使20个事实的记忆任务从近乎完美降至11%的召回率；人格约束违反率超过无用户压力下的对抗性压力基线；线性探针从残差表示中恢复召回结果的AUC高达0.99；不同架构下注意力损失与残差可解码性之间的差距可以预测目标条件行为能否在通道关闭后存活。
AI.conclusion: 提出了GAR作为诊断工具、通道转换框架作为可控的机制解释，以及窗口注意力关闭下失败时间的参数化预测方法。揭示了不同架构模型在注意力消失后表现出截然不同的失败模式，为理解和改善LLM的长对话稳定性提供了理论基础。

A parametric prediction method for determining failure timing of attention closure in LLMs under windowed attention conditions across different model architectures.

title: Sustaining AI safety: Control-theoretic external impossibility, intrinsic necessity, and structural requirements
summary: As AI systems become increasingly capable, safety strategies must be evaluated not only by how much they reduce present risk, but by whether they could sustain safety once external control can no longer reliably constrain system behavior. This paper addresses that problem by using control theory to clarify, at a structural level, whether externally enforced safety-sustaining strategies can succeed and, if not, what any alternative strategy would have to satisfy in order to be viable. It establishes two main results. First, under explicit premises including a reachability condition, it proves a class-wide external impossibility result: once the system's effects exceed what bounded external control can counteract, no strategy that depends in any degree on continued external enforcement can sustain AI safety. This failure is structural across the entire externally enforced class rather than contingent on any particular strategy. Second, it establishes a conditional class-level necessity result: if at least one candidate safety-sustaining strategy remains after that elimination, then all such remaining strategies must be intrinsic. It then states four structural requirements for viability: safety may not depend on continued external enforcement; the system's terminal objective must be safety-compatible when first formed; that objective must remain stable under self-modification; and safety must continue to be preserved as capability grows. The paper does not propose a complete strategy for sustaining AI safety. Its contribution is to give formal structure to a widely held concern about the limits of external control. It does so by deriving explicit conditional results that identify which safety-sustaining strategies are ruled out and what any remaining strategies must satisfy.

AI.tldr: 本文运用控制理论证明：当AI系统的影响力超出外部控制可抵消的范围时，任何依赖外部强制力的安全策略都将结构性失效；唯一可行的替代策略必须满足内在性要求，包括目标与安全兼容、自我修改下目标稳定、以及随能力增长安全持续保持。
AI.motivation: 现有AI安全策略仅评估当前风险降低效果，未考虑当外部控制无法可靠约束系统行为时，安全能否持续维持。本文旨在从控制理论角度，结构性分析外部强制安全策略的局限性和替代方案的必要条件。
AI.method: 采用控制理论框架，基于可达性等明确前提，从结构层面分别证明：(1) 类级外部不可能性结果——一旦系统影响超出有界外部控制可抵消范围，任何依赖外部强制力的策略均失败；(2) 类级条件必要性结果——若存在剩余候选策略，则必须为内在策略。并推导出四个结构性生存能力要求。
AI.result: 建立了两个主要结果：一是类级外部不可能性定理，证明依赖外部强制力的策略结构性失效；二是类级条件必要性定理，证明剩余策略必须为内在策略。提出了四个结构要求：安全不依赖持续外部强制、终端目标首次形成时与安全兼容、目标在自我修改下保持稳定、安全随能力增长持续保持。
AI.conclusion: 本文不提出完整安全策略，而是通过推导明确的条件性结果，为"外部控制存在根本局限"这一广泛担忧提供了形式化结构，明确了哪些策略被排除以及剩余策略必须满足的条件。

A method for classifying safety-sustaining strategies into externally enforced vs. intrinsic categories based on their dependency on continued external control

title: Position: Agentic AI System Is a Foreseeable Pathway to AGI
summary: Is monolithic scaling the only path to AGI? This paper challenges the dogma that purely scaling a single model is sufficient to achieve Artificial General Intelligence. Instead, we identify Agentic AI as a necessary paradigm for mastering the complex, heterogeneous distribution of real-world tasks. Through rigorous theoretical derivations, we contrast the optimization constraints of monolithic learners against the efficiency of Agentic systems, progressing from simple routing mechanisms to general Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) topologies. We demonstrate that Agentic AI achieves exponentially superior generalization and sample efficiency. Finally, we discuss the connection to Mixture-of-Experts, reinterpret the instability of current multi-agent frameworks, and call for greater research focus on Agentic AI.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战单模型规模化的AGI路径，提出Agentic AI（基于DAG拓扑的多智能体系统）能在泛化能力和样本效率上实现指数级优势，是通向AGI的必要范式。
AI.motivation: 挑战“仅通过单一模型规模化就足以实现AGI”的主流观点，提出Agentic AI作为掌握现实世界复杂异构任务分布的必要范式。
AI.method: 论文通过严格的理论推导，对比了单块学习器的优化约束与Agentic系统的效率，从简单路由机制到通用有向无环图(DAG)拓扑结构逐步推进。
AI.result: 证明Agentic AI在泛化能力和样本效率上具有指数级优势，并讨论了与混合专家(MoE)的联系，重新解释了当前多智能体框架的不稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 论文挑战了单一模型规模化是通向AGI唯一路径的教条，主张Agentic AI是掌握现实世界复杂异构任务分布的必要范式，并呼吁加大对Agentic AI的研究投入。

title: Retrieval is Cheap, Show Me the Code: Executable Multi-Hop Reasoning for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a standard approach for knowledge-intensive question answering, but existing systems remain brittle on multi-hop questions, where solving the task requires chaining multiple retrieval and reasoning steps. Key challenges are that current methods represent reasoning through free-form natural language, where intermediate states are implicit, retrieval queries can drift from intended entities, and errors are detected by the same model that produces them making self-reflection an unreliable, ungrounded signal.
  We observe that multi-hop question answering is a typical form of step-by-step computation, and that this structured process aligns closely with how code-specialized language models are trained to operate. Motivated by this, we introduce \pyrag, a framework that reformulates multi-hop RAG as program synthesis and execution. Instead of free-form reasoning trajectories, \pyrag represents the reasoning process as an executable Python program over retrieval and QA tools, exposing intermediate states as variables, producing deterministic feedback through execution, and yielding an inspectable trace of the entire reasoning process. This formulation further enables compiler-grounded self-repair and execution-driven adaptive retrieval without any additional training.
  Experiments on five QA benchmarks (PopQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, and Bamboogle) show that \pyrag consistently outperforms strong baselines under both training-free and RL-trained settings, with especially large gains on compositional multi-hop datasets. Our code, data and models are publicly available at https://github.com/GasolSun36/PyRAG.

AI.tldr: PyRAG将多跳RAG问题重构为Python程序合成与执行，利用代码语言模型的结构化特性，通过可执行程序表示推理过程，引入编译器驱动的自修复和执行驱动的自适应检索，在多个基准测试上优于强基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统在处理多跳问题时存在三个关键缺陷：1）自由形式自然语言推理中中间状态隐式化；2）检索查询容易偏离目标实体；3）错误检测由同一模型完成导致自反馈信号不可靠。需要一种更结构化、可检查的推理方式。
AI.method: 将多跳RAG问题形式化为程序合成与执行：1）用Python程序表示推理过程，调用检索和QA工具API；2）中间状态显式存储为变量；3）通过代码执行产生确定性反馈；4）编译器驱动的自修复机制，基于执行错误信息进行修正；5）执行驱动的自适应检索，根据程序运行结果动态调整检索策略。
AI.result: 在PopQA、HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、MuSiQue和Bamboogle五个基准上，PyRAG在无训练和强化学习训练的设置下均一致优于强基线方法，在组合型多跳数据集上提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 代码结构化的推理范式相比自由形式自然语言推理在多跳RAG任务中具有显著优势，程序合成与执行为复杂推理提供了可解释、可调试且更可靠的解决方案。
idea_en: Method for representing multi-hop QA reasoning process as executable Python program with retrieval and QA tool APIs, where intermediate states are stored as variables enabling deterministic execution feedback

Execution-driven adaptive retrieval strategy that dynamically adjusts retrieval decisions based on program execution outcomes rather than model-generated uncertainty signals

title: Useful Memories Become Faulty When Continuously Updated by LLMs
summary: Learning from past experience benefits from two complementary forms of memory: episodic traces -- raw trajectories of what happened -- and consolidated abstractions distilled across many episodes into reusable, schema-like lessons. Recent agentic-memory systems pursue the consolidated form: an LLM rewrites past trajectories into a textual memory bank that it continuously updates with new interactions, promising self-improving agents without parameter updates. Yet we find that such consolidated memories produced by today's LLMs are often faulty even when derived from useful experiences. As consolidation proceeds, memory utility first rises, then degrades, and can fall below the no-memory baseline. More surprisingly, even when consolidating from ground-truth solutions, GPT-5.4 fails on 54% of a set of ARC-AGI problems it had previously solved without memory. We trace the regression to the consolidation step rather than the underlying experience: the same trajectories yield qualitatively different memories under different update schedules, and an episodic-only control that simply retains those trajectories remains competitive with the consolidators we test. In a controlled ARC-AGI Stream environment that exposes Retain, Delete, and Consolidate actions, agents preserve raw episodes by default and double the accuracy of their forced-consolidation counterparts; disabling consolidation entirely (episodic management only) matches this auto regime. Practically, robust agent memory should treat raw episodes as first-class evidence and gate consolidation explicitly rather than firing it after every interaction. Looking forward, reliable agentic memory will require LLMs that can consolidate without overwriting the evidence they depend on.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，当前基于LLM的智能体记忆系统在将经验整合为抽象记忆时，反而会导致性能下降，甚至低于无记忆基线。保留原始经验轨迹（情景记忆）比强制整合更有效，建议将原始证据作为一等公民，审慎使用整合机制。
AI.motivation: 探索智能体记忆系统中情景记忆（原始轨迹）与整合记忆（抽象总结）之间的权衡，揭示当前LLM整合记忆机制存在的缺陷。
AI.method: 在ARC-AGI Stream环境中设计Retain、Delete、Consolidate三种操作，对比不同记忆策略（强制整合vs.情景保留vs.无记忆）对智能体性能的影响。
AI.result: 强制整合记忆的性能先升后降，甚至低于无记忆基线；GPT-5.4在已有成功经验的情况下，整合后反而在54%的问题上失败；仅保留原始情景记忆的策略与整合策略相当甚至更优。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Tutoring for Algorithm Tracing and Problem-Solving in AI Education
comment: Paper accepted to the 21st Workshop on Innovative Use of NLP for Building Educational Applications (BEA 2026), co-located with ACL 2026
summary: Students learning algorithms often need support as they interpret traces, debug reasoning errors, and apply procedures across unfamiliar problem instances. In this paper, we present KITE (Knowledge-Informed Tutoring Engine), a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based intelligent tutoring system designed to serve as a classroom teaching assistant for algorithmic reasoning and problem-solving tasks. KITE uses an intent-aware Socratic response strategy to tailor support to different student needs, responding with targeted hints, guiding questions, and progressive scaffolding intended to strengthen students' algorithmic problem-solving ability. To keep responses aligned with course content, KITE uses a multimodal RAG pipeline that retrieves relevant information from course materials. We evaluate KITE using three forms of assessment: RAGAs-based metrics for response grounding and quality, expert evaluation of pedagogical quality, and a simulated student pipeline in which a weaker language model interacts with KITE across two-turn dialogues and produces revised answers after receiving feedback. Results indicate that KITE produces contextually grounded and pedagogically appropriate responses. Further, using simulated students, KITE's feedback helped the student models produce more accurate follow-up responses on procedural and tracing questions, suggesting that its scaffolding can support algorithmic problem-solving. This work contributes a tutoring architecture and an evaluation approach for assessing retrieval-grounded explanations and scaffolded problem-solving feedback.

AI.tldr: KITE是一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）的智能辅导系统，采用意图感知的苏格拉底式回应策略，通过多模态RAG管道检索课程材料，为算法学习提供分步引导和精准反馈，帮助提升学生的问题解决能力。

AI.method: 提出KITE系统，核心包括：(1) 意图感知的苏格拉底式回应策略，根据学生需求提供靶向提示、引导问题和渐进式脚手架；(2) 多模态RAG管道，从课程材料中检索相关信息以保持回应与课程内容一致；(3) 使用RAGAs指标、专家评估和模拟学生管道（弱语言模型与KITE进行两轮对话）三种评估方式。
AI.result: KITE能生成上下文相关且教学上适当的回应。在模拟学生测试中，KITE的反馈帮助学生模型在程序和追踪问题上产生更准确的后续回答，表明其脚手架能有效支持算法问题解决。
AI.conclusion: KITE为检索-解释型辅导和脚手架式问题解决反馈提供了一种有效的教学架构和评估方法，可作为课堂助教辅助算法教学。

title: MAP: A Map-then-Act Paradigm for Long-Horizon Interactive Agent Reasoning
summary: Current interactive LLM agents rely on goal-conditioned stepwise planning, where environmental understanding is acquired reactively during execution rather than established beforehand. This temporal inversion leads to Delayed Environmental Perception: agents must infer environmental constraints through trial-and-error, resulting in an Epistemic Bottleneck that traps them in inefficient failure cycles. Inspired by human affordance perception and cognitive map theory, we propose the Map-then-Act Paradigm (MAP), a plug-and-play framework that shifts environment understanding before execution. MAP consists of three stages: (1) Global Exploration, acquiring environment-general priors; (2) Task-Specific Mapping, constructing a structured cognitive map; and (3) Knowledge-Augmented Execution, solving tasks grounded on the map. Experiments show consistent gains across benchmarks and LLMs. On ARC-AGI-3, MAP enables frontier models to surpass near-zero baseline performance in 22 of 25 game environments. We further introduce MAP-2K, a dataset of map-then-act trajectories, and show that training on it outperforms expert execution traces, suggesting that understanding environments is more fundamental than imitation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Map-then-Act Paradigm (MAP)，一种将环境理解前置的框架，通过全局探索、任务特定映射和知识增强执行三个阶段，让LLM agent先建立环境认知地图再行动，从而解决传统方法中因延迟环境感知导致的低效失败循环问题。
AI.motivation: 传统交互式LLM agent采用目标条件的分步规划方式，环境理解在执行过程中被动获取，导致"延迟环境感知"问题——agent需要通过试错推断环境约束，形成"认知瓶颈"，陷入低效的失败循环。作者受人类affordance感知和认知地图理论启发，提出应将环境理解前置到执行之前。
AI.method: MAP框架包含三个阶段：(1) 全局探索——获取环境通用先验知识；(2) 任务特定映射——构建结构化的认知地图；(3) 知识增强执行——基于已建立的地图解决任务。该框架为即插即用式设计，可适配不同LLM。
AI.result: 在多个基准和LLM上表现一致提升。在ARC-AGI-3上，MAP使前沿模型在25个游戏环境中的22个超越了接近零的基线性能。作者还构建了MAP-2K数据集，并证明在其上训练优于专家执行轨迹训练。
AI.conclusion: 理解环境比模仿行为更为根本。将环境认知前置的范式比传统的"先行动后理解"方法更高效，为LLM agent的交互决策提供了新思路。

A structured cognitive map construction method for task-specific environmental understanding
A three-stage pipeline (Exploration-Mapping-Execution) that shifts environmental perception before agent action
A knowledge-augmented execution mechanism that grounds task solving on pre-built cognitive maps
MAP-2K dataset comprising map-then-act trajectories for training agents in environment-first understanding

title: An Agentic LLM-Based Framework for Population-Scale Mental Health Screening
comment: 8 pages, conference paper presented at IEEE BigData 2025, Macau
summary: Mental health disorders affect millions worldwide, and healthcare systems are increasingly overwhelmed by the volume of clinical data generated from electronic records, telemedicine platforms, and population-level screening programs. At the same time, the emergence of novel AI-based approaches in healthcare calls for intelligent frameworks capable of processing domain-specific unstructured clinical information while adapting to patient-specific needs. This paper proposes an agentic framework for building robust LLM-based pipelines, where each stage is encapsulated as a LangChain agent governed by explicit policies and proxy-guided evaluation. Stages are incrementally locked once validated, ensuring that later adaptations cannot overwrite configurations without demonstrated improvement. The proposed framework evolves from feature-level exploration, through proxy-based tuning and freeze/rollback mechanisms, to full orchestration by an Orchestrator Agent that coordinates preprocessing, retrieval, selection, diversity, threshold optimization, and decoding. A proof-of-concept in transcript-based depression detection demonstrates that the framework converges to stable configurations, such as cosine similarity, dynamic Top-k, and threshold 0.75, while controlling evaluation costs and avoiding regressions. These results highlight the potential of agentic AI to enable population-level mental health screening over large clinical datasets, addressing critical challenges in trustworthiness, reproducibility, and adaptability required in healthcare environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Agent的LLM管道构建框架，通过将每个阶段封装为LangChain代理并采用策略与代理引导评估，实现抑郁症检测等精神健康筛查任务。框架包含特征探索、代理调优、冻结/回滚机制，最终由编排器代理协调各处理阶段，在转录级别抑郁症检测中验证了稳定性与成本控制。
AI.motivation: 精神健康障碍影响全球数百万人，医疗系统被电子记录、远程医疗平台和人群筛查产生的临床数据淹没；现有AI方法缺乏处理领域特定非结构化临床信息并适应患者特定需求的智能框架。
AI.method: 提出基于Agent的LLM管道框架，每个阶段封装为LangChain代理，由显式策略和代理引导评估控制；阶段验证后逐步锁定，防止后续修改覆盖配置；从特征探索、代理调优、冻结/回滚机制，到编排器代理协调预处理、检索、选择、多样性、阈值优化和解码。
AI.result: 在基于转录的抑郁症检测概念验证中，框架收敛到稳定配置（余弦相似度、动态Top-k、阈值0.75），控制了评估成本并避免回归。
AI.conclusion: Agentic AI有潜力实现大规模人群精神健康筛查，解决医疗环境中的可信度、可重复性和适应性挑战。

title: GRACE: Gradient-aligned Reasoning Data Curation for Efficient Post-training
summary: Existing reasoning data curation pipelines score whole samples, treating every intermediate step as equally valuable. In reality, steps within a trace contribute very unevenly, and selecting reasoning data well requires assessing them individually. We present GRACE, a gradient-aligned curation method that views each reasoning trace as a sequence of optimization events and scores every step by two complementary signals: its alignment with the answer-oriented gradient direction, and its consistency with the preceding reasoning trajectory. Step-level scores are aggregated into a sample-level value for subset selection, using only the model's internal optimization signals and no external reward models or step annotations. To make this scalable, GRACE introduces a representation-level gradient proxy that estimates step-level alignment from token-level upstream signals in a single forward pass. Post-training Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct on MMathCoT-1M, GRACE reaches 108.8% of the full-data performance with 20% of the data and retains 100.2% with only 5%, with subsets that transfer effectively across model backbones.

AI.tldr: GRACE提出一种梯度对齐的推理数据筛选方法，通过评估每一步的梯度对齐度和轨迹一致性，仅用20%数据达到108.8%的完整数据性能，无需外部奖励模型。
AI.motivation: 现有推理数据筛选方法将整个样本视为整体，但推理轨迹中各步骤贡献极不均衡，需要细粒度的步骤级评估来更有效地选择训练数据。
AI.method: GRACE将推理迹视为优化事件序列，通过两个互补信号评分每一步：与答案导向梯度方向的对齐度，以及与先前推理轨迹的一致性。引入表示级梯度代理，通过单次前向传播从token级上游信号估计步骤级对齐度。
AI.result: 在MMathCoT-1M上微调Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct，GRACE用20%数据达到108.8%的完整数据性能，用5%数据保持100.2%性能，且子集可跨模型骨干迁移。
AI.conclusion: GRACE证明步骤级梯度信号可作为推理数据筛选的有效准则，无需外部奖励模型，实现高度数据效率且具有良好的跨模型迁移性。

title: A Constraint Programming Approach for $n$-Day Lookahead Playoff Clinching
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to CP 2026
summary: In professional sports, a team has clinched the playoffs if they are guaranteed a postseason spot, regardless of the outcomes of any remaining games. As the season progresses, sports fans and other stakeholders are interested in precisely when, and under what conditions, their team will clinch the playoffs. In this paper, we investigate playoff clinching in the context of the National Hockey League (NHL), where it is computationally challenging to produce clinching scenarios due, in part, to complex tie-breakers. We present an algorithm that determines under which combinations of game outcomes in the next $n$ days a team will clinch the playoffs (i.e., "$n$-day lookahead clinching"). Our approach is a custom tree search which employs various preprocessing techniques, pruning strategies, and node ordering heuristics to efficiently explore the space of possible outcomes. The tree search leverages a constraint programming (CP)-based subroutine for inference that determines if a team has clinched the playoffs for some snapshot in time of the regular season (i.e., "0-day lookahead clinching"). This CP subroutine aims to find a counter-example in which the team being evaluated is eliminated, taking into account qualification rules and the NHL's extensive list of tie-breakers. We validate the efficacy of our algorithm using hundreds of scenarios based on public NHL data for the seasons 2021-22 through 2024-25. The methods introduced can be readily extended to other metrics of interest, including mathematical proof of playoff elimination, clinching the President's Trophy, as well as clinching (or being eliminated from clinching) any other seed in the standings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了NHL（国家冰球联盟）季后赛晋级锁定问题，提出了一种基于自定义树搜索与约束编程（CP）子程序的算法，用于确定在特定比赛结果组合下球队何时锁定季后赛席位（n天前瞻锁定），并通过百年赛季数据验证了算法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 体育迷和利益相关者希望精确知道球队在何时、何种条件下锁定季后赛席位，而NHL复杂的平局决胜规则使得计算锁定场景具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出一种自定义树搜索算法，结合预处理技术、剪枝策略和节点排序启发式，高效探索可能比赛结果空间；树搜索内部利用基于约束编程（CP）的子程序进行推理，判断球队是否在常规赛某个时间点已锁定季后赛（0天前瞻锁定），该CP子程序通过寻找反例（球队被淘汰的情况）并考虑资格规则和NHL的平局决胜规则来工作。
AI.result: 使用2021-22至2024-25赛季的数百个场景验证了算法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可扩展应用于其他指标，包括数学证明季后赛淘汰、锁定总统奖杯、以及锁定（或被淘汰于锁定）任何其他排名席位。

title: Strikingness-Aware Evaluation for Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning
summary: Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning (TKGR) aims at inferring missing (especially future) events from historical data. Current evaluation in TKGR uniformly weights all events, ignoring that most are trivial repetitions, which overestimate the true reasoning ability. Therefore, the rare outstanding events, whose prediction demands deeper reasoning, should be distinguished and emphasized. To this end, we propose a strikingness-aware evaluation framework, which introduces a rule-based strikingness measuring framework (RSMF) to quantify event strikingness by comparing its expected occurrence with peer events derived from temporal rules. Strikingness is then integrated as a weighting factor into metrics like weighted MRR and Hits@k. Experiments on four TKG benchmarks reveal: 1) All representative models perform worse as event strikingness increases, 2) Path-based methods excel on low-strikingness events and representation-based ones on high-strikingness events, 3) We design an ensemble method whose gains stem from fitting trivial events rather than reasoning improvement. Our framework provides a more rigorous evaluation, refocusing the field on predicting outstanding events.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于事件显著性的时序知识图谱推理评估框架（RSMF），通过加权指标（如加权MRR和Hits@k）更严格地评估模型对罕见、需深度推理的事件的预测能力，发现现有模型在显著性事件上表现更差，而集成方法的性能提升主要来自对琐碎事件的拟合而非真正推理能力的改进。

AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了更严格的评估标准，将领域关注点重新聚焦于预测真正需要推理能力的显著事件上。

title: Formal Conjectures: An Open and Evolving Benchmark for Verified Discovery in Mathematics
summary: As automated reasoning systems advance rapidly, there is a growing need for research-level formal mathematical problems to accurately evaluate their capabilities. To address this, we present Formal Conjectures, an evolving benchmark of currently 2615 mathematical problem statements formalized in Lean 4. Sourced from areas of active mathematical research, the dataset features 1029 open research conjectures providing a zero-contamination benchmark for mathematical proof discovery, and 836 solved problems for proof autoformalization. Notably, the repository provides a structured interface connecting mathematicians who formalize and clarify problems with the AI systems and humans attempting to solve them. Demonstrating its immediate utility, the benchmark has already been leveraged to make new mathematical discoveries, including the resolution of open research conjectures. We describe our approach to ensuring the correctness of these formalizations in a collaborative open-source project where contributions stem from an active community. In this framework, AI-generated proofs and disproofs serve as a valuable auditing mechanism to iteratively improve the fidelity of the benchmark. Finally, we provide a standardized evaluation setup and report baseline results on frozen evaluation subsets, demonstrating a climbable signal that measures the current frontier of automated reasoning on research-level mathematics.

title: Hierarchical Attacks for Multi-Modal Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Multi-modal multi-agent systems (MM-MAS) have gained increasing attention for their capacity to enable complex reasoning and coordination across diverse modalities. As these systems continue to expand in scale and functionality, investigating their potential vulnerabilities has become increasingly important. However, existing studies on adversarial attacks in multi-agent systems primarily focus on isolated agents or unimodal settings, leaving the vulnerabilities of MM-MAS largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce HAM$^{3}$, a Hierarchical Attack framework for multi-modal multi-agent systems that decomposes attacks into three interconnected layers. Specifically, at the perception layer, HAM$^{3}$ mounts attacks by perturbing visual inputs, textual inputs, and their fused visual-textual representations. At the communication layer, it performs communication-level attacks that corrupt message content and interaction topology, such as manipulating shared context or communication links to distort collective information flow. At the reasoning layer, it conducts reasoning-level attacks that interfere with each agent's cognitive pipeline, biasing reasoning trajectories and ultimately compromising final decisions. We evaluate HAM$^{3}$ on the GQA benchmark through multi-agent systems built on distinct reasoning paradigms including ReAct, Plan-and-Solve, and Reflexion. Experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves an Attack Success Rate of up to 78.3%, with reasoning-layer attacks being the most effective. More than half of the successful attacks lead multiple agents to produce consistent errors. These findings offer valuable insights for building more robust and interpretable multi-agent intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HAM³，一个针对多模态多智能体系统的分层攻击框架，从感知层、通信层和推理层三个层面实施攻击，在GQA基准测试中最高达到78.3%的攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗攻击研究主要关注单智能体或单模态场景，多模态多智能体系统(MM-MAS)的脆弱性尚未被充分探索。

AI.result: 在GQA基准测试上，利用ReAct、Plan-and-Solve、Reflexion三种推理范式构建的多智能体系统，攻击成功率最高达78.3%，其中推理层攻击效果最佳，超过半数的成功攻击导致多个智能体产生一致错误。
AI.conclusion: 该框架揭示了MM-MAS在不同层面的脆弱性，为构建更鲁棒和可解释的多智能体系统提供了重要见解。

title: An Agentic AI Framework with Large Language Models and Chain-of-Thought for UAV-Assisted Logistics Scheduling with Mobile Edge Computing
summary: In cloud manufacturing, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can support both product collection and mobile edge computing (MEC). This joint operation forms a hybrid scheduling problem, where physical logistics decisions are coupled with computational task scheduling. In this paper, UAVs collect finished products from manufacturing stations and transport them back to a central depot. Meanwhile, computational tasks generated by industrial sensor devices at these stations are processed locally, at UAVs, or offloaded via UAVs to the cloud. This coupling makes the problem challenging. A UAV can provide MEC services only during its service window at a station, so routing decisions directly determine when UAV-assisted offloading is available. Routing decisions also affect the UAV energy budget and the availability of onboard computing and communication resources for computational task execution under task deadline constraints. To address this, we propose an agentic-AI-assisted optimization framework with two components. First, we develop an agentic AI that combines large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and chain-of-thought reasoning to translate user input into an interpretable mathematical formulation for the hybrid scheduling problem. Second, we design a hierarchical deep reinforcement learning approach based on proximal policy optimization (PPO), where the upper layer learns UAV routing and the lower layer optimizes per-slot task execution and resource allocation. Simulation results show that the proposed framework yields more consistent formulations, while the hierarchical PPO achieves full product collection in 99.6% of the last 500 episodes and maintains a 100% deadline satisfaction rate, with more stable performance than the advantage actor-critic approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Agentic AI和分层深度强化学习的框架，用于解决云制造中无人机同时执行产品收集和移动边缘计算的混合调度问题，实现了99.6%的产品收集率和100%的任务截止时间满足率。

AI.result: 框架生成更一致的数学公式；分层PPO在最后500个episode中实现99.6%的产品收集率和100%的截止时间满足率，性能优于优势演员-评论家方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的Agentic AI和分层强化学习框架能有效解决无人机物流与MEC耦合的混合调度问题，具有稳定且优越的性能表现。

title: Improving Code Translation with Syntax-Guided and Semantic-aware Preference Optimization
comment: Accepted in the 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI 2016)
summary: LLMs have shown immense potential for code translation, yet they often struggle to ensure both syntactic correctness and semantic consistency. While preference-based learning offers a promising alignment strategy, it is hindered by unreliable semantic rewards derived from sparse test cases or restrictive reference translations. We argue that a robust semantic reward for code translation must be derived directly from the source code. In this paper, we propose CTO to improve code translation with syntax-guided and semantic-aware preference optimization. Through contrastive learning, we train a cross-lingual semantic model to directly assess functional equivalence between source and translated code. By formulating code translation as a multi-objective optimization problem, this robust semantic signal is seamlessly unified with compiler-based syntactic feedback within the direct preference optimization framework. Extensive experiments on C++, Java, and Python translations demonstrate that CTO significantly outperforms existing baselines and alternative preference optimization strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CTO框架，通过对比学习训练跨语言语义模型来直接评估源码与译码的功能等价性，并将语义信号与编译器语法反馈统一到直接偏好优化框架中，显著提升了代码翻译的语法正确性和语义一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代码翻译存在语法和语义不一致问题，基于偏好的对齐策略因稀疏测试用例或限制性参考翻译导致语义奖励不可靠，需要直接从源代码推导鲁棒的语义奖励。
AI.method: CTO框架：1) 通过对比学习训练跨语言语义模型，直接评估源-翻译代码的功能等价性；2) 将代码翻译建模为多目标优化问题，将语义信号与编译器语法反馈统一到直接偏好优化(DPO)框架中。
AI.result: 在C++、Java和Python翻译上的广泛实验表明，CTO显著优于现有基线和替代偏好优化策略。
AI.conclusion: 直接从源代码推导的语义奖励结合语法反馈，能有效提升代码翻译的语法正确性和语义一致性。

title: It's not the Language Model, it's the Tool: Deterministic Mediation for Scientific Workflows
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 2 appendices. Submitted to SETN 2026
summary: Language models can produce convincing scientific analyses, but repeated generations on the same data do not guarantee the same result. A researcher may regenerate an identical query and receive a different fit, a different peak position or a different analysis procedure, without an obvious way to decide which output to trust. We propose typed mediation, a pattern in which the model orchestrates deterministic tools rather than generating analytical code. Each tool encodes one researcher's exact procedure for one instrument, ported through structured interviews. The model selects which tool to call and with what parameters. The tool produces the result. Regeneration does not change it. We evaluate this claim by running the same photoluminescence analysis on four platforms, including three commercial foundation models, four times each with the same prompt. The typed tool produces identical results across all runs. The commercial platforms either vary in numerical output and analytical methodology across runs, or fail to produce valid results on the task. We deploy this pattern on two instruments serving users over approximately six months, with very positive user feedback. Both cases are very challenging: they involve proprietary binary formats and per-seat licensed software, which force the tool to remain on local infrastructure alongside the data and the instrument it operates. We argue that deployment topology is not just a preference, but a structural requirement of scientific tool mediation. The result is a practical pattern for deploying language models in scientific workflows where reproducibility is mandatory, reducing analysis time from weeks to minutes while guaranteeing identical outputs across runs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"类型化中介"模式，让语言模型调用确定性工具而非生成分析代码，从而保证科学数据分析的可重复性。四个商业平台的多轮实验表明，该模式在所有运行中产生相同结果，而商业模型输出则存在变化。在实际仪器部署中，分析时间从数周缩短至数分钟，用户反馈积极。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在相同数据上重复生成会得到不同结果（如不同的拟合、峰值位置或分析流程），研究者无法判断哪个输出可信，严重阻碍了在要求可重复性的科学工作流中的使用。
AI.method: 类型化中介（typed mediation）模式：语言模型不直接生成分析代码，而是编排调用确定性工具。每个工具通过结构化访谈编码一位研究者的精确仪器操作流程。模型仅负责选择调用哪个工具及参数，工具本身产生结果，重复生成不改变输出。
AI.result: 在四个平台（含三个商业基础模型）上对同一光致发光分析进行四轮测试，类型化工具在所有运行中产生相同结果；商业平台数值和分析方法在不同运行间存在差异，或无法产生有效结果。该模式已在两台仪器上部署约六个月，用户反馈非常积极。
AI.conclusion: 类型化中介是一种实用且有效的模式，可在需要可重复性的科学工作流中部署语言模型。部署拓扑不仅是偏好问题，而是科学工具中介的结构性要求。该模式将分析时间从数周缩短至数分钟，同时保证跨运行的输出一致性。

title: Respecting Self-Uncertainty in On-Policy Self-Distillation for Efficient LLM Reasoning
summary: On-policy self-distillation trains a reasoning model on its own rollouts while a teacher, often the same model conditioned on privileged context, provides dense token-level supervision. Existing objectives typically weight the teacher's token-level signal uniformly across a chain-of-thought sequence, despite substantial variation in the entropy of the teacher's predictive distribution. We propose EGRSD (Entropy-Guided Reinforced Self-Distillation), which unifies token-level updates through three signals: a reward-grounded direction, a teacher-student likelihood-ratio magnitude, and the proposed teacher-entropy confidence gate that down-weights high-entropy token positions while maintaining a nonzero lower bound on every token weight. We further introduce CL-EGRSD, a causal-lookahead variant that distinguishes sustained high-entropy spans from transient high-entropy positions whose following context rapidly becomes low entropy. Experiments with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B in thinking mode show that EGRSD and CL-EGRSD advance the accuracy-length frontier among the compared trainable methods.

AI.tldr: 提出EGRSD和CL-EGRSD方法，通过熵引导的置信门控机制，对自蒸馏中教师模型的token级监督信号进行非均匀加权，提升推理模型的准确率-长度前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy自蒸馏方法在chain-of-thought序列上对教师模型的token级信号进行均匀加权，忽略了教师预测分布熵的显著变化，导致高熵（不确定）token位置被不当处理。
AI.method: EGRSD统一了三种信号：奖励引导的方向、师生似然比幅度、以及教师熵置信门控（对高熵token降权但保持非零下界）。CL-EGRSD增加了因果前瞻变体，区分持续高熵区间与瞬态高熵位置。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B的thinking模式下，EGRSD和CL-EGRSD在准确率-长度前沿上优于其他可训练方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于熵的门控机制有效提升了自蒸馏中token级监督信号的质量，因果前瞻变体进一步处理了序列中熵的动态变化。
idea_en: A method for non-uniform weighting of teacher token-level supervision signals in on-policy self-distillation using teacher entropy confidence gates that down-weight high-entropy token positions while maintaining a non-zero lower bound on every token weight.

A causal-lookahead variant (CL-EGRSD) that distinguishes sustained high-entropy spans from transient high-entropy positions in chain-of-thought sequences, enabling dynamic adjustment of distillation signal weights.
A unified token-level update framework combining reward-grounded direction, teacher-student likelihood-ratio magnitude, and entropy-guided confidence gating for self-distillation of reasoning models.
An entropy-guided confidence gate mechanism that sets a non-zero lower bound on token weights to prevent complete information loss from high-entropy positions during distillation.
idea_ch: 一种基于教师熵置信门控的非均匀加权方法，在on-policy自蒸馏中对高熵token位置降权但保持非零下界，用于调整token级监督信号的权重。
CL-EGRSD因果前瞻变体，能够区分chain-of-thought序列中的持续高熵区间与瞬态高熵位置，实现蒸馏信号权重的动态调整。

title: D-VLA: A High-Concurrency Distributed Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: The rapid evolution of Embodied AI has enabled Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to excel in multimodal perception and task execution. However, applying Reinforcement Learning (RL) to these massive models in large-scale distributed environments faces severe systemic bottlenecks, primarily due to the resource conflict between high-fidelity physical simulation and the intensive VRAM/bandwidth demands of deep learning. This conflict often leaves overall throughput constrained by execution-phase inefficiencies. To address these challenges, we propose D-VLA, a high-concurrency, low-latency distributed RL framework for large-scale embodied foundation models. D-VLA introduces "Plane Decoupling," physically isolating high-frequency training data from low-frequency weight control to eliminate interference between simulation and optimization. We further design a four-thread asynchronous "Swimlane" pipeline, enabling full parallel overlap of sampling, inference, gradient computation, and parameter distribution. Additionally, a dual-pool VRAM management model and topology-aware replication resolve memory fragmentation and optimize communication efficiency. Experiments on benchmarks like LIBERO show that D-VLA significantly outperforms mainstream RL frameworks in throughput and sampling efficiency for billion-parameter VLA models. In trillion-parameter scalability tests, our framework maintains exceptional stability and linear speedup, providing a robust system for high-performance general-purpose embodied agents.

AI.tldr: D-VLA是一个面向大规模具身基础模型的高并发、低延迟分布式强化学习框架，通过平面解耦、泳道流水线、双池VRAM管理和拓扑感知复制等创新设计，解决了具身AI中物理仿真与深度学习资源冲突导致的系统瓶颈问题，在十亿级VLA模型上显著优于主流框架，并在万亿级参数规模下保持线性加速。
AI.motivation: 将强化学习应用于大规模具身基础模型（VLA模型）时，高保真物理仿真与深度学习密集的VRAM/带宽需求之间存在严重的资源冲突，导致整体吞吐量受限于执行阶段效率低下，现有系统无法有效支持大规模分布式环境下的高效训练。
AI.method: 1) 平面解耦（Plane Decoupling）：物理隔离高频训练数据与低频权重控制，消除仿真与优化之间的干扰；2) 四线程异步泳道流水线（Swimlane）：实现采样、推理、梯度计算、参数分发四个阶段的完全并行覆盖；3) 双池VRAM管理模型：解决内存碎片问题；4) 拓扑感知复制：优化通信效率。
AI.result: 在LIBERO等基准测试中，D-VLA在十亿参数VLA模型上的吞吐量和采样效率显著优于主流RL框架；在万亿级参数规模扩展性测试中保持优异的稳定性和线性加速。
AI.conclusion: D-VLA为高性能通用具身智能体提供了一套鲁棒的系统方案，能够有效支持大规模具身基础模型的分布式强化学习训练。

A four-thread asynchronous swimlane pipeline architecture for parallel overlap of sampling, inference, gradient computation, and parameter distribution in embodied AI training.
A dual-pool VRAM management model that resolves memory fragmentation in large-scale distributed RL training environments.
A topology-aware replication mechanism for optimizing communication efficiency in distributed embodied foundation model training.

title: Differentiable Learning of Lifted Action Schemas for Classical Planning
summary: Classical planners can effectively solve very large deterministic MDPs represented in STRIPS or PDDL where states are sets of atoms over objects and relations, and lifted action schemas add or delete these atoms. This compact representation yields strong search heuristics and provides an ideal setting for structural generalization, since lifted relations and action schemas give rise to infinitely many domain instances. A central challenge is to learn these relations and action schemas from data, and recent approaches have addressed this problem using different types of observations. In this work, we develop a novel neural network architecture for learning action schemas from traces where states are fully observed but action arguments are unobserved. The problem is a simplification but an important step towards learning planning domains from sequences of images and action labels, and we aim to solve this simplification in a nearly perfect manner. The challenge lies in learning the action schemas while simultaneously identifying the action arguments from observed state changes. Our approach yields a robust differentiable component that can then be integrated into larger neuro-symbolic models. We evaluate the architecture on various planning domains, where the learned lifted action schemas must recover the ground-truth structure. Additionally, we report experiments on robustness to observation noise and on a variation related to slot-based dynamics models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新颖的神经网络架构，用于从完全观测但动作参数未观测的状态轨迹中学习动作模式（action schemas），是迈向从图像序列和动作标签学习规划领域的重要一步。
AI.motivation: 经典规划器能够有效解决用STRIPS或PDDL表示的大规模确定性MDP问题，但需要预先定义提升的关系（lifted relations）和动作模式（action schemas）。如何在数据中自动学习这些结构和动作参数是一个核心挑战，尤其是在动作参数未观测的情况下。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的神经网络架构，从完全观测状态但动作参数未观测的轨迹中同时学习动作模式和识别动作参数。该方法具有可微分的鲁棒组件，可集成到更大的神经符号模型中。
AI.result: 在多个规划领域上评估，学习的提升动作模式能够恢复真实结构；同时报告了对观测噪声的鲁棒性实验以及基于槽的动态模型变体的实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法是解决动作参数未观测情况下学习动作模式的有效简化方案，为从图像序列和动作标签学习完整规划领域奠定了重要基础。
idea_en: A neural network architecture that simultaneously learns lifted action schemas and identifies unobserved action arguments from fully observed state traces.
A differentiable component that can be integrated into larger neuro-symbolic models for planning domain learning.
A method for robust learning of action schemas from noisy observation data without requiring action argument labels.
A slot-based dynamics model variation that extends the architecture for structured state representations.

title: What properties of reasoning supervision are associated with improved downstream model quality?
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the International Conference on Computational Science (ICCS) 2026
summary: Validating training data for reasoning models typically requires expensive trial-and-error fine-tuning cycles. In this work, we investigate whether the utility of a reasoning dataset can be reliably predicted prior to training using intrinsic data metrics. We propose a suite of quantitative measures and evaluate their predictive power by fine-tuning 8B and 11B models on semantically distinct variants of a Polish reasoning dataset. Our analysis reveals that these intrinsic metrics demonstrate strong and significant correlations with downstream model performance. Crucially, we find that the predictors of utility are scale-dependent: smaller models rely on alignment-focused metrics to ensure precision, whereas larger models benefit from high redundancy, utilizing verbose traces to solve complex tasks. These findings establish a scale-aware framework for validating reasoning data, enabling practitioners to select effective training sets without the need for exhaustive empirical testing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套用于预训练前预测推理数据集效用的内在指标，发现这些指标与下游模型性能显著相关，且预测因子具有规模依赖性：小模型依赖对齐聚焦指标，大模型受益于高冗余度。
AI.motivation: 验证推理模型的训练数据通常需要昂贵的试错微调周期，缺乏在训练前可靠预测数据效用的方法。
AI.method: 提出一套定量内在指标，通过在波兰语推理数据集的不同语义变体上微调8B和11B模型，评估这些指标与下游性能的预测能力。
AI.result: 内在指标与下游模型性能存在强且显著的相关性；预测因子具有规模依赖性：小模型依赖对齐聚焦指标，大模型受益于高冗余度。
AI.conclusion: 建立了规模感知的推理数据验证框架，使从业者无需大量实证测试即可选择有效训练集。
idea_en: A pre-training utility prediction method for reasoning datasets based on intrinsic quantitative metrics, enabling dataset quality assessment without trial-and-error fine-tuning.
A scale-aware data validation framework that adapts predictive metrics based on model size: alignment-focused metrics for smaller models and redundancy metrics for larger models.
A set of quantitative intrinsic metrics specifically designed for Polish reasoning datasets to predict downstream model performance before training.
A method for selecting optimal training data for reasoning models by correlating intrinsic dataset characteristics with downstream task accuracy across different model scales.

title: Discrete Diffusion for Complex and Congested Multi-Agent Path Finding with Sparse Social Attention
summary: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) is a coordination problem that requires computing globally consistent, collision-free trajectories from individual start positions to assigned goal positions under combinatorial planning complexity. In dense environments, suboptimal initial plans induce compound conflicts that hinder feasible repair. For repair-based solvers like LNS2, initial plan quality critically affects downstream repair, yet this factor remains underexplored. We propose DiffLNS, a hybrid framework that integrates a discrete denoising diffusion probabilistic model (D3PM) with LNS2. The D3PM serves as an initializer with sparse social attention that learns a spatiotemporal prior over coordinated multi-agent action trajectories from expert demonstrations and samples multiple joint plans. Operating directly on the categorical action space, our discrete diffusion preserves the MAPF action structure and samples from a multimodal joint-plan distribution to produce diverse drafts well suited for neighborhood repair. These drafts act as warm starts for downstream repair, which completes unfinished trajectories and resolves remaining conflicts under hard MAPF constraints. Experimental results show that despite being trained only on instances with at most 96 agents, the initializer generalizes to scenarios with up to 312 agents at inference time. Across 20 complex and congested settings, DiffLNS achieves an average success rate of 95.8%, outperforming the strongest tested baseline by 9.6 percentage points and matching or exceeding all baselines in all 20 settings. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to leverage discrete diffusion for warm-starting an LNS-based MAPF solver.

AI.tldr: 提出DiffLNS混合框架，将离散去噪扩散概率模型（D3PM）与LNS2结合，通过学习多智能体动作先验生成初始计划草稿，作为LNS2修复的热启动，显著提升密集环境下多智能体路径规划的成功率。
AI.motivation: 在密集环境中，次优初始计划会引发复合冲突，导致可行修复困难。对于LNS2这类基于修复的求解器，初始计划质量对下游修复至关重要，但这一因素尚未得到充分研究。
AI.method: 提出DiffLNS混合框架：(1) 使用离散去噪扩散概率模型（D3PM）作为初始化器，通过稀疏社交注意力从专家示范中学习多智能体联合动作轨迹的时空先验；(2) D3PM在分类动作空间上直接操作，从多模态联合计划分布中采样生成多样化草稿；(3) 草稿作为热启动提供给LNS2进行下游邻域修复，完成未完成轨迹并解决冲突。
AI.result: 仅在最多96个智能体实例上训练，推理时可泛化到312个智能体场景。在20个复杂拥挤场景中，平均成功率95.8%，超越最强基线9.6个百分点，在所有20个设置中匹配或超越所有基线。
AI.conclusion: 首次将离散扩散模型用于LNS-based MAPF求解器的热启动，证明了生成式初始计划对修复式求解器性能提升的有效性。

Sparse social attention mechanism within discrete diffusion that learns spatiotemporal priors over coordinated multi-agent action trajectories from expert demonstrations
Hybrid framework (DiffLNS) integrating discrete diffusion initialization with large neighborhood search (LNS2) for MAPF repair
Direct categorical action space diffusion that preserves MAPF action structure and samples from multimodal joint-plan distributions
Cross-scale generalization method where diffusion model trained on small-scale instances (≤96 agents) successfully initializes plans for large-scale scenarios (up to 312 agents)
