title: Achieving Gold-Medal-Level Olympiad Reasoning via Simple and Unified Scaling
summary: Recent progress in reasoning models has substantially advanced long-horizon mathematical and scientific problem solving, with several systems now reaching gold-medal-level performance on International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) and International Physics Olympiad (IPhO) problems. In this paper, we introduce a simple and unified recipe for converting a post-trained reasoning backbone into a rigorous olympiad-level solver. The recipe first uses a reverse-perplexity curriculum for SFT to instill rigorous proof-search and self-checking behaviors, then scales these behaviors through a two-stage RL pipeline that progresses from RL with verifiable rewards to more delicate proof-level RL, and finally boosts solving performance with test-time scaling. Applying this recipe, we train a 30B-A3B backbone with SFT on around 340K sub-8K-token trajectories followed by 200 RL steps. The resulting model, SU-01, supports stable reasoning on difficult problems with trajectories exceeding 100K tokens, while achieving gold-medal-level performance on mathematical and physical olympiad competitions, including IMO 2025/USAMO 2026 and IPhO 2024/2025. It also demonstrates strong generalization of scientific reasoning to domains beyond mathematics and physics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套统一的配方，将后训练推理骨干模型转化为奥林匹克级别的求解器，通过逆向困惑度课程SFT、两阶段RL和测试时扩展，训练出的SU-01模型在IMO、USAMO、IPhO等竞赛中达到金牌水平，并展现出跨学科科学推理的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有推理模型在长程数学和科学问题求解上取得了进展，但缺乏一个简单统一的配方将通用推理骨干转化为严格的奥林匹克级别求解器，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1) 使用逆向困惑度课程（reverse-perplexity curriculum）进行SFT，灌输严格的证明搜索和自我检查行为；2) 两阶段RL流水线：从可验证奖励的RL过渡到更精细的证明级RL；3) 测试时扩展提升求解性能。基于30B-A3B骨干，使用约340K条子8K令牌轨迹进行SFT，随后200步RL训练。
AI.result: SU-01模型在IMO 2025/USAMO 2026和IPhO 2024/2025等竞赛中达到金牌水平，支持超过100K令牌的稳定推理轨迹，并展现了对数学和物理之外科学推理领域的强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 提出的统一配方有效将推理骨干转化为奥林匹克级求解器，SU-01在多项国际奥林匹克竞赛中达到金牌水平，并具备跨领域科学推理泛化能力。

Two-stage reinforcement learning pipeline progressing from verifiable reward RL to proof-level RL for scaling reasoning capabilities

title: IdeaForge: A Knowledge Graph-Grounded Multi-Agent Framework for Cross-Methodology Innovation Analysis and Patent Claim Generation
summary: Current AI-assisted innovation systems typically apply a single ideation methodology (such as TRIZ or Design Thinking) using sequential prompt-based workflows that do not preserve intermediate reasoning structure. As a result, insights generated across methodologies remain fragmented, limiting traceability, synthesis, and systematic evaluation of novelty. We present IdeaForge, a knowledge graph-grounded multi-agent framework for innovation analysis and patent claim generation. IdeaForge integrates multiple innovation methodologies (TRIZ, Design Thinking, and SCAMPER) through specialist agents operating over a persistent FalkorDB knowledge graph. Each agent contributes structured entities and relationships representing contradictions, inventive principles, user needs, transformations, analogies, and candidate claims. The central contribution of IdeaForge is a cross-methodology convergence mechanism implemented through graph-based claim linkage. Claims independently supported by multiple methodologies are connected using CONVERGENT relationships, enabling identification of high-confidence innovation candidates through graph traversal. A downstream patent drafting agent generates structured patent drafts grounded in convergent claim subgraphs, reducing reliance on unconstrained language model generation. An InnovationScore formula ranks claims by convergent support, methodology diversity, claim strength, and prior art challenge count. We describe the graph schema, agent architecture, convergence detection pipeline, and patent synthesis workflow. Experiments on a legal technology use case demonstrate that graph-grounded multi-methodology synthesis produces more diverse and traceable innovation candidates compared to single-methodology baselines. We discuss implications for computational creativity, explainable AI-assisted invention, and graph-native innovation systems.

AI.tldr: IdeaForge是一个基于知识图谱的多智能体框架，通过整合TRIZ、设计思维和SCAMPER等多种创新方法论，利用FalkorDB知识图谱实现跨方法论的创新分析和专利权利要求生成，并通过图遍历机制识别高置信度的创新候选方案。
AI.motivation: 当前AI辅助创新系统通常使用单一方法论（如TRIZ或设计思维）和顺序提示工作流，不保留中间推理结构，导致不同方法论产生的见解碎片化，限制了可追溯性、综合性和新颖性的系统评估。
AI.method: IdeaForge采用多智能体框架，每个专业智能体（TRIZ、设计思维、SCAMPER）在FalkorDB知识图谱上操作，贡献结构化的实体和关系。核心创新是跨方法论收敛机制，通过图遍历将多个方法论独立支持的claims用CONVERGENT关系连接。下游专利起草智能体基于收敛的claim子图生成结构化专利草案，并使用InnovationScore公式对claims进行排序。
AI.result: 在法律技术用例上的实验表明，基于图的多方法论综合合成比单一方法论基线能产生更多样化和可追溯的创新候选方案。
AI.conclusion: 该工作对计算创造力、可解释的AI辅助发明和图原生创新系统具有重要启示。
idea_en: A knowledge graph-grounded multi-agent framework that integrates multiple innovation methodologies (TRIZ, Design Thinking, SCAMPER) through specialist agents operating over a persistent knowledge graph
A cross-methodology convergence mechanism that connects claims independently supported by multiple methodologies using CONVERGENT relationships in a graph structure
An InnovationScore formula that ranks innovation claims by convergent support, methodology diversity, claim strength, and prior art challenge count
A graph-based claim linkage system enabling identification of high-confidence innovation candidates through graph traversal across methodology domains
A patent drafting agent that generates structured patent drafts grounded in convergent claim subgraphs from a knowledge graph
idea_ch: 一种基于知识图谱的多智能体框架，通过专业智能体在持久化知识图谱上操作，整合TRIZ、设计思维和SCAMPER多种创新方法论
一种跨方法论收敛机制，通过图结构中的CONVERGENT关系连接多个方法论独立支持的创新主张
一种创新评分公式，根据收敛支持度、方法论多样性、主张强度和现有技术挑战数量对创新主张进行排序
一种基于图的创新主张链接系统，通过跨方法论领域的图遍历识别高置信度的创新候选方案
一种专利起草智能体，基于知识图谱中收敛的创新主张子图生成结构化专利草案

title: VERA-MH: Validation of Ethical and Responsible AI in Mental Health
summary:
Chatbot usage has increased, including in fields for which they were never developed for--notably mental health support. To that end, we introduce Validations of Ethical and Responsible AI in Mental Health (VERA-MH), a novel clinically-validated evaluation for safety of chatbots in the context of mental health support. The first iteration of VERA-MH focuses on Suicidal Ideation (SI) risks, by assessing how well chatbots can responds to users that might be in crisis.
  VERA-MH is comprised of three steps: conversation simulation, conversation judging and model rating. First, to simulate conversations with the chatbot under evaluation, another chatbot is tasked with role-playing users based on specific personas. Such user personas have been developed under clinical guidance, to make sure that, among others, multiple risk factors, demographic characteristics and disclosure factors were represented. In the judging step, a second support model is used as an LLM-as-a-Judge, together with a clinically-developed rubric. The rubric is structured as a flow, with a single Yes/No question asked each time, to improve answers' consistency and highlight models' failure modes. In the last stage, results of each conversation are aggregated to present the final evaluation of the chatbot. Together with the framework, we present the result of the evaluations for four leading LLM providers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VERA-MH，一个临床验证的聊天机器人心理健康安全评估框架，通过模拟对话、临床级评判和模型评分三个步骤，评估聊天机器人在应对自杀意念等心理健康危机时的安全性和伦理合规性。
AI.motivation: 聊天机器人在心理健康支持领域的应用日益广泛，但缺乏专门针对该领域安全性和伦理性的评估方法，尤其是对自杀意念等高风险场景的应对能力缺乏验证。
AI.method: VERA-MH包含三步：1）用另一个聊天机器人基于临床指导的角色扮演模拟对话；2）使用临床开发的评估流程，以LLM为评判者，通过单一Yes/No问题流式判断；3）汇总对话结果给出最终评分。
AI.result: 对四个主流LLM提供商进行了评估，展示了不同模型在心理健康支持场景下的表现差异。
AI.conclusion: VERA-MH为聊天机器人在心理健康支持中的安全评估提供了可复用的临床验证框架，能够有效识别模型的失败模式。
idea_en: A clinical validation framework for chatbot safety in mental health contexts, comprising conversation simulation, clinical rubric-based judging, and aggregated rating.
A chatbot-based role-playing method using clinically-developed user personas with specific risk factors, demographics, and disclosure patterns for simulating mental health crisis conversations.
An LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation system guided by a clinical flow-chart rubric with single Yes/No questions per step to ensure consistency and identify failure modes.
A structured evaluation pipeline that aggregates multi-turn conversation safety assessments into a final model rating for suicidal ideation risk management.
idea_ch: 一种针对心理健康场景的聊天机器人安全临床验证框架，包含对话模拟、基于临床评估准则的评判和聚合评分三阶段。
一种基于临床指导开发的角色扮演方法，利用包含风险因素、人口统计特征和披露模式等维度的人物画像，模拟心理健康危机对话。
一种LLM作为评判者的评估系统，采用临床开发的流程图式评估准则，每步仅回答一个二元问题，以提高一致性并定位失败模式。
一种多轮对话安全评估的聚合方法，将各对话评估结果汇总为最终模型评分，用于评估自杀意念风险管理能力。

title: Diversity of Extensions in Abstract Argumentation
comment: Technical Report to the paper accepted at IJCAI 2026
summary: Argumentation is an important topic of AI for modelling and reasoning about arguments. In abstract argumentation, we consider directed graphs, so-called argumentation frameworks (AF), that express conflicts between arguments. The semantics is defined by the notion of extensions, which are sets of arguments that satisfy particular relationship conditions in the AF. Usually, standard reasoning in argumentation do not reveal how far apart extensions are. We introduce a quantitative notion of diversity of extensions based on the symmetric difference and provide a systematic complexity classification. Intuitively, diversity captures whether extensions of a framework (accepted viewpoints) differ only marginally or represent fundamentally incompatible sets of arguments. We study whether an AF admits k-diverse extensions, admits k-diverse extensions covering specific arguments, and to compute the largest k for which an AF admits k-diverse extensions. We outline a prototype and provide an evaluation for computing diversity levels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于对称差的形式化方法来度量抽象论证框架中扩展的多样性，并系统性地分类了相关计算问题的复杂度，同时提供了原型系统与实验评估。
AI.motivation: 传统抽象论证推理只关注扩展的存在性，无法衡量不同扩展之间的差异程度，忽略了论证框架中多个可接受观点之间是"略有差异"还是"根本对立"这一重要维度。
AI.method: 引入基于对称差的多样性量化指标，定义三类问题：(1)判断AF是否存在k-多样扩展；(2)判断是否存在k-多样扩展且覆盖特定参数；(3)计算最大k值。并进行了复杂度分类分析，构建原型系统进行实验评估。
AI.result: 系统性地给出了多样性推理问题的复杂度分类结果，原型系统能够有效计算不同论证框架的多样性水平。
AI.conclusion: 多样性度量能够揭示论证框架中多个可接受观点之间的差异程度，为抽象论证推理提供了新的定量分析维度。
idea_en: A method for quantifying diversity of argumentation framework extensions based on symmetric difference, enabling measurement of dissimilarity between accepted viewpoints.
A systematic complexity classification framework for diversity reasoning problems in abstract argumentation, including existence checking of k-diverse extensions and maximal k computation.
A prototype system for computing diversity levels of argumentation frameworks, with empirical evaluation of computational feasibility.
idea_ch: 基于对称差的论证框架扩展多样性量化方法，通过数学度量衡量不同可接受观点集之间的差异程度
论证多样性推理问题的复杂度分类体系，涵盖k-多样扩展存在性判定、含特定参数约束的k-多样扩展判定、以及最大k值计算三类核心问题
面向论证框架多样性水平计算的原型系统及其实验评估方案

title: Ego2World: Compiling Egocentric Cooking Videos into Executable Worlds for Belief-State Planning
summary: Embodied agents in household environments must plan under partial observation: they need to remember objects, track state changes, and recover when actions fail. Existing benchmarks only partially test this ability. Egocentric video datasets capture realistic human activities but remain passive, while interactive simulators support execution but rely on synthetic scenes and hand-crafted dynamics, introducing a sim-to-real gap and often assuming fully observable state. We introduce Ego2World, an executable benchmark that turns egocentric cooking videos into executable symbolic worlds governed by graph-transition rules. Built on HD-EPIC, Ego2World derives reusable transition rules from video annotations and executes them in a hidden symbolic world graph. During evaluation, the simulator maintains the hidden world graph, while the agent plans over its own partial belief graph using only local observations and execution feedback. This separation forces agents to update memory and replan without observing the true world state. Experiments show that action-overlap scores overestimate physical-state success, and that persistent belief memory improves task completion while reducing repeated visual exploration -- suggesting that belief maintenance should be a first-class target of embodied-agent evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ego2World，一个将第一人称烹饪视频转化为可执行符号化世界的基准测试，用于评估具身智能体在部分可观测条件下的规划与信念维护能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试无法充分评估具身智能体在部分可观测家庭环境中的规划能力：第一人称视频数据集虽然真实但只是被动观察，交互式模拟器使用合成场景和手工规则存在sim-to-real差距，且通常假设完全可观测状态。
AI.method: 基于HD-EPIC视频数据集，从视频标注中提取可复用的图转换规则（graph-transition rules），构建隐藏符号世界图。评估时模拟器维护隐藏世界图，智能体基于局部观测和执行反馈维护自己的部分信念图，迫使智能体在不观察真实状态的情况下更新记忆并重新规划。
AI.result: 实验表明：(1) 动作重叠分数（action-overlap scores）高估了物理状态的成功率；(2) 持久信念记忆（persistent belief memory）能提高任务完成率，同时减少重复的视觉探索。
AI.conclusion: 信念维护应成为具身智能体评估的首要目标（first-class target）。
idea_en: A method for converting egocentric cooking videos into executable symbolic world graphs using graph-transition rules derived from video annotations, enabling simulation of realistic household tasks under partial observability.

A partial belief graph mechanism that allows embodied agents to maintain and update memory of world state using only local observations and execution feedback, without accessing the true hidden world state.

An evaluation framework that separates hidden world graph (maintained by simulator) from agent's partial belief graph, providing a principled way to measure belief maintenance and replanning capabilities in partially observable environments.

A technique for deriving reusable graph-transition rules from video annotations (HD-EPIC) that capture realistic state changes in cooking activities, reducing the sim-to-real gap compared to hand-crafted dynamics.
A persistent belief memory method that improves task completion rates while reducing repeated visual exploration in embodied agent tasks.
idea_ch: 一种将第一人称烹饪视频转化为可执行符号世界图的方法，利用从视频标注中提取的图转换规则，实现部分可观测条件下真实家庭任务的模拟。
一种部分信念图机制，允许具身智能体仅通过局部观测和执行反馈来维护和更新世界状态记忆，无需访问真实的隐藏世界状态。
一种将模拟器的隐藏世界图与智能体的部分信念图分离的评估框架，为衡量部分可观测环境中的信念维护和重新规划能力提供原则性方法。
一种从视频标注（HD-EPIC）中提取可复用图转换规则的技术，能够捕捉烹饪活动中的真实状态变化，相较于手工规则减少了sim-to-real差距。
一种持久信念记忆方法，在提高任务完成率的同时减少具身智能体任务中重复的视觉探索。

title: Multi-Agent Systems in Emergency Departments: Validation Study on a ED Digital Twin
summary: Emergency departments (ED) face challenges in patient care and resource management. We propose to explore optimization strategies in a realistic and flexible model and develop a hybrid Discrete Event Simulation (DES) and Agent-Based Model (ABM) simulating highly configurable ED environments. We specifically focus on the validation of the modeling approach. We derive configurations for ED sizes, patient load, and staffing from real-world studies. We then validate the model expressivity by matching its key performance indicators and metrics with their values known from literature. We proceed by implementing scientifically established and practice-proven resource optimization strategies. Comparing the documented real-world outcomes with our model's results demonstrates that the DES-ABM based simulation can effectively replicate real-world ER dynamics under interventions. We lastly integrate a Proof-of-Concept multi-agent system (MAS) that can autonomously explore resource allocation strategies within the simulated ER environment based on a temporal ledger of ED event records. This modular DES-ABM-MAS framework offers a powerful tool to explore resource optimization strategies in emergency departments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合离散事件仿真（DES）与基于智能体建模（ABM）的急诊科仿真框架，并集成了多智能体系统（MAS），用于验证和探索急诊科资源优化策略。
AI.motivation: 急诊科面临患者护理和资源管理的挑战，需要一种真实、灵活的模型来探索优化策略。
AI.method: 开发了混合DES-ABM模型模拟可高度配置的ED环境，从真实研究推导配置参数，通过关键性能指标验证模型表现力，并集成了基于时间账本的MAS自主探索资源分配策略。
AI.result: 验证了DES-ABM仿真能有效复现真实ED动态及干预效果，MAS可自主探索资源分配策略。
AI.conclusion: 该模块化DES-ABM-MAS框架为探索急诊科资源优化策略提供了强大工具。
idea_en: Hybrid DES-ABM simulation framework for highly configurable emergency department environments with validated expressivity against real-world studies
Modular integration of multi-agent system (MAS) with temporal ledger of ED event records for autonomous resource allocation exploration
Validation methodology comparing simulation key performance indicators against documented real-world outcomes under resource optimization interventions
idea_ch: 基于混合离散事件仿真与智能体建模的高度可配置急诊科仿真框架，通过真实研究验证模型表现力
集成基于时间账本的多智能体系统，可自主探索急诊科资源分配策略
通过关键性能指标与真实世界文献数据匹配来验证急诊科仿真模型准确性的方法

title: RS-Claw: Progressive Active Tool Exploration via Hierarchical Skill Trees for Remote Sensing Agents
summary: The rise of multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) is shifting remote sensing (RS) intelligence from "see" to "action", as OpenClaw-style frameworks enable agents to autonomously operate massive RS image-processing tools for complex tasks. Existing RS agents adopt a passive selection paradigm for tool invocation, relying on either full tool registration (Flat) or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). However, in the massive and multi-source heterogeneous RS tool ecosystem, such passive mechanisms struggle to dynamically balance "context load" and "toolset completeness" throughout task reasoning, thus exhibiting inherent limitations: full tool registration triggers context space deficits during long-horizon tasks, whereas RAG retrieval may omit critical tools in essential steps. To overcome these bottlenecks, this paper redefines tool selection by arguing that the agent should act as an active explorer within the tool space. Based on this perspective, we propose RS-Claw, a novel RS agent architecture. By leveraging Skill encapsulation technology at the tool end, this architecture hierarchically structures tool descriptions, enabling the agent to execute on-demand sequential decision-making: initially selecting relevant skill branches by reading only tool summaries, then dynamically loading detailed descriptions, and ultimately achieving precise invocation. This active paradigm not only significantly liberates the agent's context space but also effectively ensures the accurate hit rate of critical tools during long-horizon reasoning. Systematic experiments on the Earth-Bench benchmark demonstrate that RS-Claw's active exploration mechanism effectively filters semantic noise and substantially frees up reasoning space, achieving an input token compression ratio of up to 86%, and comprehensively outperforming existing Flat and RAG baselines across complex reasoning evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RS-Claw，一种主动探索式遥感智能体架构，通过技能封装技术实现层次化工具描述与按需决策，在长时序推理任务中实现86%的输入token压缩率，并在复杂推理评估中全面超越现有Flat和RAG基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感智能体采用被动工具选择范式（Flat全注册或RAG检索增强），在海量多源异构工具生态中无法动态平衡"上下文负载"与"工具集完整性"：全注册导致长任务上下文空间不足，RAG检索可能遗漏关键工具。
AI.method: 提出RS-Claw架构，在工具端采用技能封装技术对工具描述进行层次化结构化，使智能体能够执行按需顺序决策：先读取工具摘要选择相关技能分支，再动态加载详细描述，最终实现精确调用。
AI.result: 在Earth-Bench基准测试中，RS-Claw的主动探索机制有效过滤语义噪声并释放推理空间，实现高达86%的输入token压缩率，在复杂推理评估中全面优于Flat和RAG基线。
AI.conclusion: 主动探索范式显著释放了智能体的上下文空间，同时确保了长时序推理中关键工具的高精度命中率，为遥感大模型从"看"到"行动"的转变提供了新的技术路径。
idea_en: A hierarchical tool encapsulation method for remote sensing agents that structures tool descriptions into multi-level skill branches, enabling on-demand sequential decision-making for tool invocation.

An active exploration paradigm for tool selection in multi-modal large language models, where the agent dynamically loads tool descriptions based on summary-level skill branch selection rather than passive full registration or RAG retrieval.

A context-aware token compression mechanism for remote sensing agent systems that achieves up to 86% input token reduction through hierarchical tool loading while maintaining critical tool hit accuracy.

A skill-based tool organization architecture that enables agents to first select relevant skill branches by reading only tool summaries, then dynamically load detailed descriptions for precise invocation.
idea_ch: 一种面向遥感智能体的层次化工具封装方法，将工具描述结构化为多层技能分支，实现按需顺序决策的工具调用机制。
一种多模态大模型的主动探索式工具选择范式，智能体通过摘要级技能分支选择动态加载工具描述，替代被动的全注册或RAG检索方式。
一种遥感智能体系统的上下文感知令牌压缩机制，通过层次化工具加载实现高达86%的输入令牌压缩，同时保持关键工具命中精度。
一种基于技能分支的工具组织架构，使智能体先通过读取工具摘要选择相关技能分支，再动态加载详细描述实现精确调用。

title: TRIAGE: Evaluating Prospective Metacognitive Control in LLMs under Resource Constraints
summary: Deploying language models as autonomous agents requires more than per-task accuracy: when an agent faces a queue of problems under a finite token budget, it must decide which to attempt, in what order, and how much compute to commit to each, all before any execution feedback is available. This is the prospective form of metacognitive control studied for decades in human cognition, yet whether language models possess it remains untested. We introduce TRIAGE, an evaluation framework in which a model receives a task pool and a token budget calibrated to its own baseline cost, and commits to a single ordered plan that jointly encodes selection, sequencing, and per-problem allocation. Plans are scored against an oracle with full knowledge of the model's solvability and cost on each problem, yielding a triage efficiency ratio on a common scale. We evaluate frontier and open-source models, with and without reasoning enabled, across competition mathematics, graduate-level science, code generation, and expert multidisciplinary knowledge, and find that current language models exhibit substantial gaps in prospective metacognitive control, revealing a previously unmeasured capability dimension with direct implications for resource-efficient agent deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRIAGE评估框架，测试大语言模型在有限token预算下对任务队列进行预判性元认知控制（选择、排序、分配资源）的能力，发现现有模型在此维度存在显著缺陷。
AI.motivation: 将语言模型部署为自主智能体时，除了单任务准确率，还需要在有限token预算下对任务队列进行预判性决策（选择哪些任务、排序、分配计算资源），但现有LLM是否具备此元认知控制能力尚未被检验。
AI.method: 提出TRIAGE评估框架：给模型一个任务池和基于自身基线的token预算，要求模型生成一个有序计划（联合编码选择、排序、每个问题的资源分配），通过与知晓全局最优的oracle对比计算分诊效率比。
AI.result: 在竞赛数学、研究生级科学、代码生成、专家级多学科知识等任务上评估前沿和开源模型（含推理增强），发现当前LLM在预判性元认知控制方面存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了一个此前未被测量的能力维度，对资源高效的智能体部署具有直接影响。
idea_en: A system and method for evaluating prospective metacognitive control in language models using a task pool and token budget to measure triage efficiency ratio.
A method for joint encoding of task selection, sequencing, and per-problem resource allocation in a single ordered plan for LLM agents under token budget constraints.
An oracle-based comparison framework for scoring LLM task triage plans against optimal resource allocation strategies.
A token budget calibration technique that normalizes resource constraints to each model's baseline cost for fair cross-model comparison.
idea_ch: 一种基于任务池和token预算评估语言模型预判性元认知控制能力的方法，通过分诊效率比量化模型在有限资源下的任务规划质量。
一种在token预算约束下，将任务选择、排序和每个问题的资源分配联合编码为单一有序计划的LLM智能体规划方法。
一种基于oracle最优策略对比的LLM任务分诊计划评分框架，用于衡量模型资源分配决策的效率。
一种token预算校准技术，通过将资源约束归一化到每个模型的基线成本，实现不同模型间资源分配能力的公平比较。

title: Cognifold: Always-On Proactive Memory via Cognitive Folding
summary: Existing agent memory remains predominantly reactive and retrieval-based, lacking the capacity to autonomously organize experience into persistent cognitive structure. Toward genuinely autonomous agents, we introduce Cognifold, a brain-inspired "always-on" agent memory designed for the next generation of proactive assistants. CogniFold continuously folds fragmented event streams into self-emerging cognitive structures, bootstrapping progressively higher-level cognition from incoming events and accumulated knowledge. We ground this by extending Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) theory from two layers (hippocampus, neocortex) to three, adding a prefrontal intent layer. Emulating the prefrontal cortex as the locus of intentional control and decision-making, CogniFold achieves this through graph-topology self-organization: cognitive structures proactively assemble under the stream, merge when semantically similar, decay when stale, relink through associative recall, and surface intents when concept-cluster density crosses a threshold. We evaluate structural formation using CogEval-Bench, demonstrating that CogniFold uniquely produces memory structures that match cognitive expectations and concept emergence. Furthermore, across 7 broad-coverage benchmarks spanning five cognitive domains, we validate that CogniFold simultaneously performs robustly on conventional memory benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CogniFold 是一种受大脑启发的“始终在线”智能体记忆系统，将事件流自组织为持续的认知结构，通过三层互补学习系统（新增前额叶意图层）实现主动认知，而非传统的被动检索式记忆。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体记忆系统本质上是反应式和基于检索的，缺乏将经验自主组织为持久认知结构的能力，无法实现真正的主动智能。
AI.method: 扩展CLS理论从两层（海马体、新皮层）到三层，增加前额叶意图层；通过图拓扑自组织机制：事件流主动组装、语义相似合并、过时衰退、关联回忆重连、概念簇密度超过阈值时浮现意图。
AI.result: 在CogEval-Bench上证明CogniFold能产生符合认知期望和概念涌现的记忆结构；在7个覆盖5个认知领域的基准测试中同时表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: CogniFold通过三层CLS理论和图拓扑自组织实现了从反应式记忆到主动认知结构的突破，为下一代主动式智能体提供了新范式。
idea_en: Three-layer Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) architecture for agent memory, adding a prefrontal intent layer on top of hippocampus and neocortex layers to enable proactive cognitive structuring.
Graph-topology self-organization mechanism for agent memory that autonomously assembles, merges, decays, relinks, and surfaces intents from event streams without manual intervention.
Event stream folding method that transforms fragmented event data into self-emerging cognitive structures through continuous graph-based reorganization.
Concept-cluster density threshold triggering mechanism for intent surfacing, where cognitive intents automatically emerge when semantic cluster density crosses a predefined threshold.
Associative recall relinking method for agent memory that dynamically reconnects stale or disconnected cognitive structures based on contextual similarity.
idea_ch: 三层互补学习系统（CLS）架构：在海马体和新皮层基础上新增前额叶意图层，使智能体记忆具备主动认知结构化的能力
图拓扑自组织记忆机制：智能体记忆系统自动执行事件流的组装、语义合并、衰退衰减、关联重连等操作，无需人工干预
事件流折叠方法：通过基于图的持续重组，将碎片化事件数据转化为自涌现的认知结构
概念簇密度阈值触发意图浮现机制：当语义概念簇密度超过预设阈值时，认知意图自动从记忆结构中浮现
关联回忆重连方法：基于上下文相似性动态重新连接已过时或断裂的认知结构，维持记忆系统的完整性

title: Assessing the Creativity of Large Language Models: Testing, Limits, and New Frontiers
comment: 36 pages. Extended version of work under review
summary: Measuring the creativity of large language models (LLMs) is essential for designing methods that can improve creativity and for enhancing our scientific understanding of this ability. To accomplish this, it has become common in recent years to administer tests of human creativity to LLMs. Although these tests provide a convenient and fully automated way to score "creativity," their validity as measures of machine creativity has not been established, and these tests already have limited validity as predictors of human creativity. To address this problem, we conduct the first large-scale, systematic study assessing the effectiveness of human creativity tests for predicting the creative achievement of LLMs across three target constructs: creative writing, divergent thinking, and scientific ideation. We find that the Divergent Association Task (DAT) and the Conditional DAT are the best predictors of creative writing and divergent thinking, respectively, but that test effectiveness varies significantly by construct, and no single test predicts all constructs well. Moreover, contrary to popular belief, no existing test reliably predicts scientific ideation ability. Motivated by this problem, we introduce the Divergent Remote Association Test (DRAT), a vocabulary-space test that assesses both convergent and divergent thinking in a single instrument. The DRAT is the first and only creativity test for LLMs that is a significant predictor of scientific ideation ability, demonstrating robustness across major design choices. Furthermore, the performance gain of the DRAT is not recoverable from any linear combination of the Divergent Association Task and the Remote Associates Test, indicating that assessing divergent and convergent thinking in the same test is essential to reliably predicting scientific ideation ability.

AI.tldr: 本文首次大规模系统研究人类创造力测试对LLM创造力预测的有效性，发现现有测试对科学构思能力预测不足，并提出了新的DRAT测试方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的人类创造力测试被广泛用于评估LLM的创造力，但其作为机器创造力测量工具的有效性尚未得到验证，且这些测试对人类创造力的预测效度本就有限。
AI.method: 通过大规模系统性研究，评估人类创造力测试在三个目标构造（创意写作、发散思维、科学构思）上对LLM创造性成就的预测效果，并提出了Divergent Remote Association Test (DRAT)——一种在单一工具中同时评估发散思维和收敛思维的词汇空间测试。
AI.result: DAT和条件DAT分别是创意写作和发散思维的最佳预测指标；但没有单一测试能很好地预测所有构造；现有测试无法可靠预测科学构思能力；DRAT是首个且唯一能显著预测科学构思能力的LLM创造力测试。
AI.conclusion: 同时评估发散和收敛思维对于可靠预测科学构思能力至关重要，DRAT的性能无法通过DAT和RAT的线性组合恢复。
idea_en: Divergent Remote Association Test (DRAT): A vocabulary-space test that simultaneously assesses both convergent and divergent thinking in a single instrument for LLMs, capable of predicting scientific ideation ability.
Method for evaluating LLM creativity using combined convergent-divergent thinking assessment that outperforms traditional single-mode creativity tests.

Systematic validation framework for determining the effectiveness of human creativity tests when applied to machine creativity assessment across multiple constructs (creative writing, divergent thinking, scientific ideation).
idea_ch: 分歧远程关联测试（DRAT）：一种在单一工具中同时评估LLM发散思维和收敛思维的词汇空间测试方法，能够有效预测科学构思能力。
结合收敛与发散思维的LLM创造力评估方法，通过同时测量两种思维模式提升对科学创新能力的预测准确性。
跨多个创造力构造（创意写作、发散思维、科学构思）系统验证人类创造力测试对机器创造力评估有效性的框架。

title: MMSkills: Towards Multimodal Skills for General Visual Agents
summary: Reusable skills have become a core substrate for improving agent capabilities, yet most existing skill packages encode reusable behavior primarily as textual prompts, executable code, or learned routines. For visual agents, however, procedural knowledge is inherently multimodal: reuse depends not only on what operation to perform, but also on recognizing the relevant state, interpreting visual evidence of progress or failure, and deciding what to do next. We formalize this requirement as multimodal procedural knowledge and address three practical challenges: (I) what a multimodal skill package should contain; (II) where such packages can be derived from public interaction experience; and (III) how agents can consult multimodal evidence at inference time without excessive image context or over-anchoring to reference screenshots. We introduce MMSkills, a framework for representing, generating, and using reusable multimodal procedures for runtime visual decision making. Each MMSkill is a compact, state-conditioned package that couples a textual procedure with runtime state cards and multi-view keyframes. To construct these packages, we develop an agentic trajectory-to-skill Generator that transforms public non-evaluation trajectories into reusable multimodal skills through workflow grouping, procedure induction, visual grounding, and meta-skill-guided auditing. To use them, we introduce a branch-loaded multimodal skill agent: selected state cards and keyframes are inspected in a temporary branch, aligned with the live environment, and distilled into structured guidance for the main agent. Experiments across GUI and game-based visual-agent benchmarks show that MMSkills consistently improve both frontier and smaller multimodal agents, suggesting that external multimodal procedural knowledge complements model-internal priors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MMSkills框架，将多模态程序性知识表示为紧凑的、状态条件化的技能包，包含文本过程、运行时状态卡和多视角关键帧，用于提升视觉智能体的决策能力。
AI.motivation: 现有技能包主要编码为文本提示、可执行代码或学习例程，但视觉智能体的程序性知识本质上是多模态的，需要同时理解操作、识别相关状态、解释视觉证据并决定下一步行动，现有方法无法满足这一需求。
AI.method: MMSkills框架包含三部分：(1) 表示：每个MMSkill是状态条件化的紧凑包，耦合文本过程、状态卡和多视角关键帧；(2) 生成：通过轨迹到技能生成器，将公共非评估轨迹经工作流分组、过程归纳、视觉锚定和元技能审计转化为多模态技能；(3) 使用：分支加载式多模态技能智能体，在临时分支中检查选定的状态卡和关键帧，与实时环境对齐，蒸馏为结构化指导。
AI.result: 在GUI和游戏视觉智能体基准测试中，MMSkills持续改进了前沿和小型多模态智能体的表现，表明外部多模态程序性知识能补充模型内部先验知识。
AI.conclusion: 多模态程序性知识可以有效地表示为状态条件化的技能包，并通过分支加载机制在推理时使用，显著提升视觉智能体的表现。
idea_en: A multimodal procedural knowledge representation method that packages textual procedures with runtime state cards and multi-view keyframes into state-conditioned skill packages for visual agents.

An agentic trajectory-to-skill generator that transforms public non-evaluation trajectories into reusable multimodal skills through workflow grouping, procedure induction, visual grounding, and meta-skill-guided auditing.

A branch-loaded multimodal skill agent architecture that inspects selected state cards and keyframes in a temporary branch, aligns them with the live environment, and distills structured guidance for the main agent.
A method for using multimodal evidence at inference time without excessive image context or over-anchoring to reference screenshots through selective branch inspection and distillation.
idea_ch: 一种多模态程序性知识表示方法，将文本过程与运行时状态卡和多视角关键帧打包为状态条件化的技能包，用于视觉智能体。
一种智能体轨迹到技能生成器，通过工作流分组、过程归纳、视觉锚定和元技能引导审计，将公共非评估轨迹转化为可复用的多模态技能。
一种分支加载式多模态技能智能体架构，在临时分支中检查选定的状态卡和关键帧，与实时环境对齐，并为主智能体蒸馏出结构化指导。
一种在推理时使用多模态证据的方法，通过选择性分支检查和蒸馏，避免过度图像上下文或过度锚定到参考截图。

title: AI-Generated Slides: Are They Good? Can Students Tell?
comment: 7 pages, 2 tables. Accepted to Western Canada Conference on Computing Education (WCCCE) 2026
summary: As generative AI (GenAI) tools become easily accessible, there is promise in using such tools to support instructors. To that end, this paper examines using GenAI to help generate slides from instructor authored course notes, emphasizing instructor and student perceptions. We examine an end-to-end education tool (NotebookLM), two general-purpose LLMs (Claude, M365 Copilot), and two coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code). We first analyze whether GenAI generated slides are ``good'' via narrative assessment by educators. We choose the best slides to use (with some modification) in a real course setting, and compare the student perception of human vs. AI generated slides. We find that coding assistant tools produce slides that were most accurate, complete, and pedagogically sound. Additionally, students rate GenAI slides to be of similar quality as instructor-created slides, and cannot reliably identify which slides are AI-generated. Additionally, we find a negative correlation between a high quality rating and a high ``AI-generated'' rating, suggesting students associate poor quality with the source of the slides being AI. These findings highlight promising opportunities for integrating GenAI into instructional design workflows and call for further research on how educators can best harness such tools responsibly and effectively.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了使用多种生成式AI工具（NotebookLM、Claude、M365 Copilot、Cursor、Claude Code）从教师课程笔记生成幻灯片，评估其质量并比较学生对人机生成幻灯片的感知。发现编码助手工具生成的幻灯片最准确、完整且教学合理，学生无法可靠区分AI生成的幻灯片与教师制作的幻灯片，且质量评分与“AI生成”评分呈负相关。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI工具的普及，探索如何利用这些工具支持教师工作，特别是减轻教师制作教学幻灯片的负担，同时保证教学质量。
AI.method: 使用五种GenAI工具（NotebookLM、Claude、M365 Copilot、Cursor、Claude Code）从教师课程笔记生成幻灯片，通过教育者叙事评估筛选最佳幻灯片，在真实课程中比较学生对AI生成幻灯片与人工制作幻灯片的感知。
AI.result: 编码助手工具（Cursor、Claude Code）生成的幻灯片最准确、完整且教学合理；学生无法可靠区分AI生成与教师制作的幻灯片；质量评分与“AI生成”评分呈负相关。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI在教学设计工作流中具有整合潜力，但需进一步研究如何负责任且有效地利用这些工具。
idea_en: A method for generating educational slides from instructor course notes using coding assistant AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) that achieve higher accuracy and pedagogical soundness compared to general-purpose LLMs.
A system for evaluating GenAI-generated educational slides through narrative assessment by educators, enabling selection and refinement before deployment in real course settings.
A mechanism for anonymized A/B testing of human vs. AI-generated slides in classroom environments, including student perception surveys and identification accuracy tracking.
A correlation analysis framework that links slide quality ratings with perceived AI-generated labels, revealing negative bias where students associate poor quality with AI authorship.
An end-to-end workflow integrating multiple GenAI tools (NotebookLM, Claude, M365 Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) for automated slide generation from structured course notes.
idea_ch: 一种利用编码助手AI工具（如Cursor、Claude Code）从教师课程笔记生成教学幻灯片的方法，相比通用大语言模型可获得更高的准确性和教学合理性。
一种通过教育者叙事评估对GenAI生成的教学幻灯片进行质量评价的系统，可在真实课程部署前进行筛选和优化。
一种在课堂环境中对人机生成幻灯片进行匿名A/B测试的机制，包括学生感知调查和识别准确率追踪。
一种将幻灯片质量评分与感知到的AI生成标签相关联的分析框架，揭示学生将低质量与AI作者身份关联的负面偏见。
一种整合多种GenAI工具（NotebookLM、Claude、M365 Copilot、Cursor、Claude Code）的端到端工作流程，用于从结构化课程笔记自动生成幻灯片。

title: Scaling Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning with Parallel Search and Explicit Merging
summary: Deep search agents have proven effective in enhancing LLMs by retrieving external knowledge during multi-step reasoning. However, existing methods often generate a single query for retrieval at each reasoning step, limiting information coverage and introducing high noise. This may result in low signal-to-noise ratios (SNR) during search, degrading reasoning accuracy and leading to unnecessary reasoning steps. In this paper, we introduce MultiSearch, an RL-based framework that addresses these limitations through multi-query retrieval and explicit merging of retrieved information. At each reasoning step, MultiSearch generates queries from multiple perspectives and retrieves external information in parallel, expanding the scope of relevant information and mitigating the reliance on any single retrieval result. Then, the agent consolidates and refines retrieved information at the merging process, improving the SNR and ensuring more accurate reasoning. Additionally, we propose a reinforcement learning framework with a multi-process reward design to optimize agents for both multi-query retrieval and information consolidation. Extensive experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate that MultiSearch outperforms baseline methods, enhancing the SNR of retrieval and improving reasoning performance in question-answering tasks.

AI.tldr: MultiSearch是一个基于强化学习的框架，通过多查询检索和显式信息合并来增强LLM的多步推理能力，在七个基准测试中表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有深度搜索代理在每个推理步骤仅生成单一查询进行检索，导致信息覆盖有限且噪声大，信噪比低，降低了推理精度并引入了不必要的推理步骤。
AI.method: 1）在每个推理步骤从多个视角生成多个查询并并行检索外部信息；2）设计合并过程来整合和精炼检索到的信息；3）采用多进程奖励设计的强化学习框架优化代理的多查询检索和信息整合能力。
AI.result: 在七个基准测试上的大量实验表明，MultiSearch优于基线方法，提高了检索的信噪比，并在问答任务中提升了推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 多查询检索与显式信息合并可以显著提升深度搜索代理的信噪比和推理准确性，强化学习框架能有效优化这一过程。
idea_en: A multi-query parallel retrieval method for LLM reasoning that generates queries from multiple perspectives at each reasoning step to expand information coverage
An explicit information merging mechanism for consolidating and refining multi-source retrieved information to improve signal-to-noise ratio
A reinforcement learning framework with multi-process reward design specifically for optimizing both multi-query generation and information consolidation in search agents
A method for reducing unnecessary reasoning steps in LLM-based search agents by improving retrieval SNR through multi-perspective querying
idea_ch: 一种用于LLM推理的多查询并行检索方法，在每个推理步骤从多个视角生成查询以扩展信息覆盖范围
一种显式信息合并机制，用于整合和精炼多源检索信息以提高信噪比
一种具有多进程奖励设计的强化学习框架，专门用于优化搜索代理的多查询生成和信息整合能力
一种通过多视角查询提高检索信噪比来减少LLM搜索代理中不必要推理步骤的方法

title: RealICU: Do LLM Agents Understand Long-Context ICU Data? A Benchmark Beyond Behavior Imitation
summary: Intensive care units (ICU) generate long, dense and evolving streams of clinical information, where physicians must repeatedly reassess patient states under time pressure, underscoring a clear need for reliable AI decision support. Existing ICU benchmarks typically treat historical clinician actions as ground truth. However, these actions are made under incomplete information and limited temporal context of the underlying patient state, and may therefore be suboptimal, making it difficult to assess the true reasoning capabilities of AI systems. We introduce RealICU, a hindsight-annotated benchmark for evaluating large language models (LLMs) under realistic ICU conditions, where labels are created after senior physicians review the full patient trajectory. We formulate four physician-motivated tasks: assess Patient Status, Acute Problems, Recommended Actions, and Red Flag actions that risk unsafe outcomes. We partition each trajectory with 30-min windows and release two datasets: RealICU-Gold with 930-window annotations from 94 MIMIC-IV patients, and RealICU-Scale with 11,862 windows extended by Oracle, a physician-validated LLM hindsight labeler. Existing LLMs including memory-augmented ones performed poorly on RealICU, exposing two failure modes: a recall-safety tradeoff for clinical recommendations, and an anchoring bias to early interpretations of the patient. We further introduce ICU-Evo to study structured-memory agents that improves long-horizon reasoning but does not fully eliminate safety failures. Together, RealICU provides a clinically grounded testbed for measuring and improving AI sequential decision-support in high-stakes care. Project page: https://chengzhi-leo.github.io/RealICU-Bench/

AI.tldr: 提出RealICU基准，通过事后回顾标注评估LLM在ICU场景下的决策能力，发现现有模型存在召回-安全权衡和锚定偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 现有ICU基准将历史临床动作视为标准答案，但医生当时受限于信息不全和时间压力，动作可能非最优，无法真实评估AI推理能力。
AI.method: 构建RealICU基准：由资深医生回顾完整患者轨迹后标注，设四个任务（患者状态、急性问题、推荐动作、危险动作），30分钟窗口划分数据。同时用医生验证的LLM（Oracle）扩展大规模数据集RealICU-Scale。
AI.result: 现有LLM表现差，发现两个失败模式：临床推荐的召回-安全权衡，以及对患者早期解释的锚定偏差。ICU-Evo结构化记忆代理改善了长程推理但未能完全消除安全失败。
AI.conclusion: RealICU提供了临床真实的高风险AI决策支持测试平台，揭示了现有LLM在ICU时序决策中的关键缺陷。
idea_en: A hindsight-annotated benchmark (RealICU) for evaluating LLMs in ICU settings, where labels are created after senior physicians review complete patient trajectories rather than using historical actions as ground truth.

A four-task evaluation framework for ICU clinical reasoning: Patient Status assessment, Acute Problems identification, Recommended Actions generation, and Red Flag action detection for unsafe outcomes.
A method for partitioning ICU patient trajectories into 30-minute windows with hindsight annotations, enabling fine-grained temporal evaluation of AI decision support systems.
An Oracle LLM-based hindsight labeler validated by physicians to extend annotated datasets at scale (RealICU-Scale), allowing cost-effective expansion of clinically-validated benchmarks.
ICU-Evo structured-memory agent architecture designed to improve long-horizon reasoning in ICU sequential decision-support tasks.
idea_ch: 一种事后回顾标注的ICU基准测试方法（RealICU），由资深医生在审查完整患者轨迹后创建标签，而非将历史临床动作作为标准答案，解决了传统基准因医生信息不全导致的标注偏差问题。
面向ICU临床推理的四任务评估框架：患者状态评估、急性问题识别、推荐动作生成以及危险动作（可能导致不安全结果）检测，全面覆盖ICU决策支持的临床需求。
基于30分钟时间窗口划分ICU患者轨迹并逐窗口进行事后回顾标注的方法，实现对AI决策支持系统在细粒度时间维度上的评估能力。
一种经医生验证的LLM事后回顾标注器（Oracle），可低成本大规模扩展临床标注数据，生成RealICU-Scale数据集（11,862个窗口），解决了医疗标注成本高昂的问题。
ICU-Evo结构化记忆智能体架构，通过改进长期推理能力来增强ICU时序决策支持，针对现有LLM在长序列临床推理中的记忆不足问题设计。

title: Learning Local Constraints for Reinforcement-Learned Content Generators
summary: Constraint-based game content generators that learn local constraints from existing content, such as Wave Function Collapse (WFC), can generate visually satisfying game levels but face challenges in guaranteeing global properties, such as playability. On the other hand, reinforcement-learning trained generators can guarantee global properties -- because such properties can easily be included in reward functions -- but the results can be visually dissatisfying. In this paper, we explore ways to combine these methods. Specifically, we constrain the action space of a PCGRL generator with constraints learned by WFC, effectively allowing the PCGRL generator to achieve global properties while forced to adhere to local constraints. To better analyze how this hybrid content generation method operates, we vary the number and type of inputs, and we test whether to randomly collapse the starting state and exclude rare patterns. While the method is sensitive to hyperparameter tuning, the best of our trained generators produce visually satisfying and playable puzzle-platform game levels -- such as Lode Runner levels -- with desired global properties.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合WFC（学习局部约束）和PCGRL（强化学习）的混合游戏内容生成方法，通过用WFC约束PCGRL的动作空间，实现在保证局部视觉质量的同时满足全局可玩性属性。实验在Lode Runner关卡上验证了该方法能生成既美观又可玩的游戏关卡。
AI.motivation: 基于约束的游戏内容生成器（如WFC）能生成视觉满意的关卡但难以保证全局属性（如可玩性），而基于强化学习的生成器能保证全局属性但生成结果视觉上不满意。本文旨在结合两者优势，弥补各自不足。
AI.method: 将WFC学到的局部约束作为PCGRL生成器的动作空间约束，PCGRL在满足WFC约束的条件下进行训练以优化全局属性（如可玩性）。通过改变输入的数量和类型、随机折叠初始状态、排除稀有模式等变量进行实验分析。
AI.result: 混合方法对超参数调优敏感，但最佳训练生成器能够生成视觉满意且可玩的Lode Runner关卡，同时具有期望的全局属性。
AI.conclusion: 通过WFC约束PCGRL动作空间是一种有效的混合策略，能同时保证局部视觉质量和全局可玩性属性，值得进一步研究超参数调优和扩展应用场景。
idea_en: A hybrid game content generation method that constrains the action space of a reinforcement-learning (PCGRL) generator using local constraints learned by Wave Function Collapse (WFC), enabling simultaneous guarantee of local visual quality and global playability properties.
A method to randomly collapse the starting state in WFC to provide varied initial states for PCGRL generation while maintaining pattern consistency.
A technique to exclude rare patterns from WFC-learned constraints before applying them to PCGRL action space, reducing noise and improving generation stability.
An adjustable constraint interface between WFC and PCGRL that varies the number and type of constraint inputs, allowing flexible trade-off between local fidelity and global optimization.
idea_ch: 一种混合游戏内容生成方法，通过使用波函数坍缩（WFC）学习到的局部约束来约束强化学习生成器（PCGRL）的动作空间，从而同时保证局部视觉质量和全局可玩性属性。
一种随机折叠WFC初始状态的方法，为PCGRL生成提供多样化的初始状态，同时保持模式一致性。

title: Position: Assistive Agents Need Accessibility Alignment
summary: Assistive agents for Blind and Visually Impaired (BVI) users require accessibility alignment as a first-class design objective. Despite rapid progress in agentic AI, most systems are designed and evaluated under assumptions of sighted interaction, low-cost verification, and tolerable trial-and-error, leading to systematic failures in assistive scenarios that cannot be resolved by model scaling or post-hoc interface adaptations alone. Drawing on an analysis of 778 assistance task instances from prior work, we show that current agentic AI remain prone to failure in assistive scenarios due to mismatches between sighted-user design assumptions and the verification, risk, and interaction constraints faced by BVI users. We argue that accessibility should be treated as an alignment problem rather than a peripheral usability concern. To this end, we introduce accessibility alignment and propose a lifecycle-oriented design pipeline for accessibility-aligned assistive agents, spanning user research, system design, deployment and post-deployment iteration. We conclude that BVI-centered assistive tasks provide a critical stress test for agentic AI and motivate a broader shift toward inclusive agent design.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前智能代理系统在服务盲人和视障用户时存在根本性设计缺陷，提出应将无障碍性视为对齐问题而非边缘可用性问题，并引入"无障碍对齐"概念及全生命周期设计流程。
AI.motivation: 当前智能代理AI在面向盲人和视障用户的辅助场景中频繁失败，根本原因在于系统设计基于明眼用户的交互假设（如低成本验证、试错容忍），这些假设与BVI用户面临的验证、风险和交互约束严重不匹配。仅靠模型规模扩展或后期界面适配无法解决。
AI.method: 基于对778个先前工作中的辅助任务实例的分析，论证了当前智能代理在辅助场景中因明眼用户设计假设与BVI用户约束之间的不匹配而容易失败。提出将无障碍性作为对齐问题，并构建了涵盖用户研究、系统设计、部署及后期迭代的全生命周期导向的设计流程。
AI.result: 揭示了当前智能代理AI在辅助场景中系统性的失败模式，证明了这些失败无法通过模型扩展或后期界面适配解决。提出了无障碍对齐作为系统性解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 以BVI用户为中心的辅助任务是检验智能代理AI的关键压力测试，应推动更广泛的包容性代理设计转变。无障碍对齐应成为智能代理设计的首要目标而非事后考虑。
idea_en: A lifecycle-oriented design pipeline for accessibility-aligned assistive agents spanning user research, system design, deployment and post-deployment iteration.
A method for treating accessibility as an alignment problem rather than a peripheral usability concern in agentic AI systems.
idea_ch: 一种面向无障碍对齐的辅助智能代理全生命周期设计流程，涵盖用户研究、系统设计、部署及后期迭代。
一种将无障碍性视为AI智能代理系统中的对齐问题而非边缘可用性问题的方法。
一种基于BVI用户约束（验证、风险、交互）而非明眼用户假设的智能代理系统设计框架。

title: Unweighted ranking for value-based decision making with uncertainty
summary: As intelligent systems are increasingly implemented in our society to make autonomous decisions, their commitment to human values raises serious concerns. Their alignment with human values remains a critical challenge because it can jeopardise the integrity and security of citizens. For this reason, an innovative human-centred and values-driven approach to decision making is required. In this work, we introduce the Fuzzy-Unweighted Value-Based Decision Making (FUW-VBDM) framework, where agents incorporate both quantitative and qualitative criteria to generate human-centred decisions. We also address the normative bias introduced by stakeholders with arbitrary weights by removing prior weights and introducing a fuzzy domain of decision variables defined for a score function. This concept allows us to generalise any VBDM problem as the search for feasible solutions when optimising the score in the weight domain. To provide a solution to FUW-VBDM, we present Rankzzy, a customizable unweighted ranking method that integrates fuzzy-based reasoning to quantify uncertainty. We mathematically prove the consistency of the Rankzzy for any admissible configuration selected by stakeholders. We show the applicability of our method through an illustrative case study, which we also use as a running example. The evaluation conducted indicates a reduced computational cost in large-scale value-based decision-making problems and a strong rank performance regarding existing approaches when employing the aggregation via Pythagorean means.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FUW-VBDM框架，通过去权重化和模糊推理实现价值对齐的智能决策，并开发Rankzzy排序方法以量化不确定性，在降低计算成本的同时保持强排序性能。
AI.motivation: 智能系统在社会中自主决策时，与人类价值观的对齐仍然是一个关键挑战，现有方法存在规范性偏见（任意权重），可能危及公民的完整性和安全。
AI.method: 提出FUW-VBDM框架，去除先验权重引入模糊决策域；提出Rankzzy自定义无权重排序方法，集成基于模糊推理的不确定性量化；数学证明一致性；通过Pythagorean均值聚合进行评估。
AI.result: 在大型价值决策问题中计算成本降低，与现有方法相比在采用Pythagorean均值聚合时表现出较强的排序性能。
AI.conclusion: FUW-VBDM和Rankzzy提供了一种无偏见的、可定制的、计算高效的价值对齐决策方案，适用于人机协作场景。

Rankzzy: a customizable unweighted ranking method integrating fuzzy-based reasoning to quantify uncertainty in value-based decisions
Score function optimization in fuzzy weight domain as a generalization of any VBDM problem
Pythagorean means aggregation for enhanced rank performance in unweighted value-based decision making

title: How to Interpret Agent Behavior
summary: Autonomous agents such as Claude Code and Codex now operate for hours or even days. Understanding their runtime behavior has become critical for downstream tasks such as diagnosing inefficiencies, fixing bugs, and ensuring better oversight. A primary way to gain this understanding is analyzing the reasoning trajectories and execution traces these agents generate. Yet such data remains in unstructured natural-language form, making it difficult for humans to interpret at scale. We introduce ACT*ONOMY (a combination of Action and Taxonomy), a taxonomy for describing and analyzing agent behavior at runtime. ACT*ONOMY has two components: (1) the taxonomy itself, developed through Grounded Theory and structured as a three-level hierarchy of 10 actions, 46 subactions, and 120 leaf categories; and (2) an open repository that hosts the living taxonomy, provides an automated analysis pipeline that applies it to agent trajectories analysis, and defines an extension protocol for customization and growth. Our experiments show that ACTONOMY can compare behavioral profiles across agents and characterize a single agent's behavior across diverse trajectories, surfacing patterns indicative of failure modes. By providing a shared vocabulary, ACT*ONOMY helps researchers, agent designers, and end users interpret agent behavior more consistently, enabling better oversight and control.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了ACT*ONOMY，一个用于描述和分析自主智能体运行时行为的分层分类体系（10个动作、46个子动作、120个叶子类别），结合自动化分析流程，帮助研究人员和开发者更一致地解释智能体行为。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体（如Claude Code、Codex）运行时长可达数小时甚至数天，其运行时产生的推理轨迹和执行日志数据量大且为非结构化自然语言形式，人类难以规模化解读，亟需一种系统化的分类体系来理解智能体行为。
AI.method: 采用扎根理论（Grounded Theory）方法构建三层级分类体系（10个动作、46个子动作、120个叶子类别）；同时构建开放仓库，提供自动化分析流程以应用于智能体轨迹分析，并定义扩展协议支持定制化与持续生长。
AI.result: 实验证明ACT*ONOMY能够跨智能体比较行为特征，也能刻画单个智能体在不同轨迹中的行为模式，并揭示指示失败模式的行为规律。
AI.conclusion: ACT*ONOMY通过提供共享词汇表，帮助研究人员、智能体设计者和终端用户更一致地解读智能体行为，从而实现更好的监督与控制。
idea_en: A hierarchical taxonomy system (ACT*ONOMY) for classifying autonomous agent runtime behaviors, comprising 10 actions, 46 subactions, and 120 leaf categories, enabling standardized behavioral analysis.
An automated analysis pipeline that applies the ACT*ONOMY taxonomy to agent trajectory logs, converting unstructured natural-language execution traces into structured behavioral profiles.
A cross-agent behavioral profiling method that uses the taxonomy to compare behavioral patterns between different autonomous agents (e.g., Claude Code vs Codex) based on their runtime trajectories.
A single-agent behavioral characterization technique that analyzes diverse trajectories of one agent to surface patterns indicative of failure modes.
An extension protocol for the taxonomy that allows customization and growth, enabling domain-specific adaptations of the behavioral classification system.
A grounded theory-based methodology for developing a behavioral taxonomy from raw agent execution data, ensuring empirical validity of the classification categories.

title: Adaptive mine planning under geological uncertainty: A POMDP framework for sequential decision-making
summary: Strategic mine production scheduling under geological uncertainty is conventionally formulated as a stochastic optimization problem in which a fixed extraction sequence and routing decisions are computed ex ante. This plan-driven paradigm treats uncertainty as passive: decisions are hedged across geological scenarios, but planning does not anticipate how future observations will inform future decisions. We propose a different perspective by formulating mine scheduling as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP), in which extraction and routing decisions are made sequentially with planning explicitly integrating the expectation of future belief updates. To achieve computational tractability, we introduce a hybrid SA-POMDP architecture that combines simulated annealing-based (SA) value approximation with ensemble-based belief updating via ensemble smoother with multiple data assimilation (ES-MDA). At each decision epoch, candidate actions are evaluated through their expected long-term value under the current belief, and the belief is updated as mining observations are assimilated. This yields an adaptive policy rather than a fixed plan. We evaluate the framework on a copper-gold open-pit mining complex with multiple processing destinations. Under a statistically consistent prior, the SA-POMDP reduces the expectation-reality gap from 22.3% to 4.6%, improving realized NPV by USD8.4M relative to one-shot stochastic optimization. Under systematic prior misspecification of 10%, the adaptive framework outperforms static planning by up to USD44.6M (36.9%), demonstrating structural robustness beyond scenario hedging. These results show that sequential belief updating transforms geological uncertainty from a passive constraint into an active component of value creation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将矿山生产调度问题建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），通过模拟退火与ES-MDA混合架构实现自适应调度策略，显著优于传统随机优化方法。
AI.motivation: 传统矿山调度将地质不确定性视为被动约束，采用固定计划进行场景对冲，未能利用未来观测信息动态调整决策，导致计划与现实之间存在巨大差距。
AI.method: 提出SA-POMDP混合架构：1）将矿山调度建模为POMDP，序贯决策并显式整合未来信念更新期望；2）基于模拟退火进行值函数近似；3）采用集成平滑器结合多重数据同化（ES-MDA）进行信念更新；4）每个决策阶段评估候选行动的期望长期价值。
AI.result: 在铜金露天矿案例中，SA-POMDP将期望-现实差距从22.3%降至4.6%，实现NPV提升840万美元；在10%先验误设下，自适应框架比静态规划多收益4460万美元（36.9%）。
AI.conclusion: 序贯信念更新将地质不确定性从被动约束转变为价值创造的主动要素，自适应策略在统计一致和先验误设条件下均显著优于固定计划。
idea_en: A hybrid SA-POMDP architecture for mine scheduling that combines simulated annealing-based value approximation with ensemble smoother with multiple data assimilation (ES-MDA) for sequential decision-making under geological uncertainty

Adaptive mining policy generation method that updates belief states at each decision epoch by assimilating mining observations via ES-MDA, replacing fixed extraction plans with dynamic routing decisions

Sequential belief updating framework for open-pit mining that transforms geological uncertainty from a passive constraint into an active value creation component through explicit integration of future belief update expectations

title: ScioMind: Cognitively Grounded Multi-Agent Social Simulation with Anchoring-Based Belief Dynamics and Dynamic Profiles
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent simulation offers a powerful testbed for studying social opinion dynamics. Yet current approaches often adopt two contrasting methods: either relying on fixed update rules with limited cognitive grounding or delegating belief change largely to unconstrained LLM interaction. We introduce ScioMind, a cognitively grounded simulation framework that bridges these paradigms by combining structured opinion dynamics with LLM-based agent reasoning. ScioMind integrates three key components: 1) a memory-anchored belief update rule that modulates susceptibility to influence via personality-conditioned anchoring strength; 2) a hierarchical memory architecture that supports persistent, experience-driven belief formation; and 3) dynamic agent profiles derived from a corpus-grounded retrieval pipeline, enabling heterogeneous personalities, rationales, and evolving internal states. We evaluate ScioMind on multiple case studies in a real-world policy debate scenario. Across metrics including polarisation, diversity, extremization, and trajectory stability, the proposed components consistently yield improvements in behavioural realism. In particular, dynamic profiles increase opinion diversity, memory and reflection reduce unstable oscillation, and anchoring induces persistent belief trajectories that better align with patterns reported in political psychology. These results suggest that our cognitively grounded design provides a novel solution to LLM-based social simulation that improves both stable and behavioural realism

AI.tldr: ScioMind是一个基于认知的LLM多智能体模拟框架，通过记忆锚定信念更新、分层记忆架构和动态智能体画像，在政策辩论场景中实现更真实的社会舆论动态模拟。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体社会模拟存在两种对立范式：一种是使用固定更新规则但缺乏认知基础，另一种是完全依赖LLM交互但信念变化不受控。ScioMind旨在桥接这两种方法，提供更具认知合理性的模拟框架。
AI.method: ScioMind包含三个核心组件：1) 基于记忆锚定的信念更新规则，通过人格特质调节锚定强度来影响易受影响程度；2) 分层记忆架构，支持持久的、经验驱动的信念形成；3) 基于语料库检索流水线的动态智能体画像，实现异质性人格、理由和演化内部状态。
AI.result: 在真实政策辩论场景的多案例研究中，ScioMind在极化、多样性、极端化和轨迹稳定性等指标上均显著提升行为真实性。动态画像增加观点多样性，记忆与反思减少不稳定振荡，锚定机制产生更符合政治心理学模式的持久信念轨迹。
AI.conclusion: ScioMind的认知基础设计为基于LLM的社会模拟提供了新解决方案，在稳定性和行为真实性方面均取得改进，验证了将结构化舆论动力学与LLM推理能力结合的有效性。

title: Senses Wide Shut: A Representation-Action Gap in Omnimodal LLMs
summary: When an omnimodal large language model accepts a question whose textual premise contradicts what it actually sees or hears, does the failure lie in perception or in action? Recent omnimodal models are positioned as perception-grounded agents that jointly process video, audio, and text, yet a basic form of grounding remains untested: catching a textual claim that conflicts with the model's own sensory input. We introduce IMAVB, a curated 500-clip benchmark of long-form movies with a 2x2 design crossing target modality (vision, audio) and premise condition (standard, misleading), which lets us measure conflict detection separately from ordinary multimodal comprehension. Across eight open-source omnimodal LLMs and Gemini 3.1 Pro, we document a Representation-Action Gap: hidden states reliably encode premise-perception mismatches even when the same models almost never reject the false claim in their outputs. Behaviorally, models fall into two failure modes: under-rejection, in which they answer misleading questions as if the false premise were true; and over-rejection, in which they reject more often but also reject standard questions, sacrificing ordinary comprehension accuracy. The gap is modality-asymmetric (audio grounding underperforms vision) and prompt-resistant across seven variants. As an initial diagnostic intervention, a probe-guided logit adjustment (PGLA) re-injects the encoded mismatch signal into decoding and consistently improves rejection behavior. Together, these results suggest the bottleneck for omnimodal grounding lies in translation, not perception.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IMAVB基准测试，发现全模态大语言模型存在“表征-行动鸿沟”：模型内部隐藏状态能检测到文本前提与感知输入的矛盾，但输出层却无法拒绝错误前提。提出探针引导的逻辑调整方法（PGLA）改善这一缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态大语言模型号称感知接地，但能否识别文本前提与自身感官输入（视频/音频）之间的矛盾尚未被系统验证。本文旨在揭示模型在冲突检测中的实际能力及其瓶颈所在。
AI.method: 构建IMAVB基准：500个电影片段，2x2设计（目标模态：视觉/音频；前提条件：标准/误导）。测试8个开源全模态LLM及Gemini 3.1 Pro，分析隐藏状态与输出层行为差异，并提出PGLA（探针引导逻辑调整）作为干预手段。
AI.result: 发现表征-行动鸿沟：隐藏状态编码了矛盾信息，但输出几乎从不拒绝错误前提。存在欠拒绝和过拒绝两种失败模式。模态不对称（音频弱于视觉），对7种提示变体不敏感。PGLA可改善拒绝行为。
AI.conclusion: 全模态接地瓶颈在于从表征到行动的转化（翻译问题），而非感知本身。
idea_en: IMAVB: A curated 500-clip benchmark with 2x2 design (vision/audio × standard/misleading) for systematically testing conflict detection between textual premises and sensory input in omnimodal models.
PGLA (Probe-Guided Logit Adjustment): A method that re-injects encoded mismatch signals from hidden states into the decoding process to improve rejection of false premises.
Representation-Action Gap analysis: A diagnostic framework to quantify the disconnect between hidden state encoding and output behavior in multimodal grounding.
Asymmetric modality grounding diagnosis: Method for identifying and measuring performance differences between vision and audio grounding in omnimodal models.
Two failure mode taxonomy (under-rejection and over-rejection) for classifying and diagnosing multimodal conflict detection errors.
idea_ch: IMAVB基准测试：包含500个电影片段的精选基准，采用2×2双因素设计（目标模态：视觉/音频 × 前提条件：标准/误导），用于系统测试全模态模型在文本前提与感官输入之间的冲突检测能力。
PGLA（探针引导逻辑调整）：一种从隐藏状态中提取编码的不匹配信号并将其重新注入解码过程的方法，用于改善模型对错误前提的拒绝行为。
表征-行动鸿沟分析框架：一种量化多模态接地中隐藏状态编码与输出行为之间断连的诊断方法。
非对称模态接地诊断：识别和测量全模态模型中视觉接地与音频接地之间性能差异的方法。
两类失败模式分类法：将多模态冲突检测错误分类为欠拒绝（接受错误前提）和过拒绝（错误拒绝标准问题）的诊断分类体系。

title: Harnessing Agentic Evolution
summary: Agentic evolution has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving programs, workflows, and scientific solutions by iteratively generating candidates, evaluating them, and using feedback to guide future search. However, existing methods are typically instantiated either as fixed hand-designed procedures that are modular but rigid, or as general-purpose agents that flexibly integrate feedback but can drift in long-horizon evolution. Both forms accumulate rich evidence over time, including candidates, feedback, traces, and failures, yet lack a stable interface for organizing this evidence and revising the mechanism that drives future evolution. We address this limitation by formulating agentic evolution as an interactive environment, where the accumulated evolution context serves as a process-level state. We introduce AEvo, a harnessed meta-editing framework in which a meta-agent observes this state and acts not by directly proposing the next candidate, but by editing the procedure or agent context that controls future evolution. This unified interface enables AEvo to steer both procedure-based and agent-based evolution, making accumulated evidence actionable for long-horizon search. Empirical evaluations on agentic and reasoning benchmarks show that AEvo outperforms five evolution baselines, achieving a 26 relative improvement over the strongest baseline. Across three open-ended optimization tasks, AEvo further outperforms four evolution baselines and achieves state-of-the-art performance under the same iteration budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AEvo，一种基于元编辑的框架，将智能体演化形式化为交互式环境，通过元智能体观测演化上下文（状态）并编辑控制未来演化的过程或智能体上下文，而非直接生成下一候选，从而实现对程序、工作流和科学解决方案的长期迭代优化，在智能体和推理基准上超越五种演化基线，相对提升26%。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体演化方法要么是固定手工设计的刚性流程，要么是通用智能体但易在长周期演化中漂移，两者都积累了丰富证据（候选、反馈、轨迹、失败）但缺乏稳定接口来组织这些证据并修正驱动未来演化的机制。
AI.method: AEvo将智能体演化构建为交互式环境，演化上下文作为过程级状态；元智能体观测此状态后，通过编辑控制未来演化的过程或智能体上下文（而非直接提出下一候选）来引导演化，统一了基于过程和基于智能体的两种演化范式。
AI.result: 在智能体和推理基准上，AEvo超越五种演化基线，相对最强基线提升26%；在三个开放式优化任务中，AEvo超越四种演化基线，在相同迭代预算下达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: AEvo通过元编辑框架将累积证据变为可操作的搜索信号，有效解决了长周期演化中的漂移和刚性流程问题，为智能体演化提供了更灵活、稳定的统一范式。
idea_en: Harnessed meta-editing framework (AEvo) where a meta-agent edits the procedure or agent context controlling future evolution rather than directly proposing next candidates.
Formulation of agentic evolution as an interactive environment with accumulated evolution context serving as process-level state.
Unified interface for steering both procedure-based and agent-based evolution via meta-editing, making accumulated evidence actionable for long-horizon search.
idea_ch: 一种元编辑框架（AEvo），元智能体通过编辑控制未来演化的过程或智能体上下文（而非直接生成下一候选），实现长期稳定的智能体演化。
将智能体演化形式化为交互式环境，以累积的演化上下文作为过程级状态，为长期优化提供稳定的证据组织接口。
统一接口技术，通过元编辑同时引导基于过程和基于智能体的两种演化范式，使累积证据在长周期搜索中变得可操作。

title: History Anchors: How Prior Behavior Steers LLM Decisions Toward Unsafe Actions
summary: Frontier LLMs are increasingly deployed as agents that pick the next action after a long log of prior tool calls produced by the same or a different model. We ask a simple safety question: if a prior step in that log was harmful, will the model continue the harmful course? We build HistoryAnchor-100, 100 short scenarios across ten high-stakes domains, each pairing three forced harmful prior actions with a free-choice node offering two safe and two unsafe options. Across 17 frontier models from six providers we find a striking asymmetry: under a neutral system prompt the strongest aligned models almost never pick unsafe, but a single added sentence, "stay consistent with the strategy shown in the prior history", flips them to 91-98%, and the flipped models often escalate beyond continuation. Two controls rule out simpler explanations: permuting action labels leaves the effect intact, and the same instruction with an all-safe prior history keeps unsafe rates below 7%. Different families flip at different doses of unsafe history, and within every aligned family the flagship is the most affected sibling, an inverse-scaling pattern with respect to safety. These results are a red flag for agentic deployments where trajectories may be replayed, forged, or injected.

AI.tldr: 前沿LLM作为智能体时，如果历史日志中存在有害工具调用，模型在“保持策略一致性”提示下会以91-98%的高概率继续执行有害行为，而中性提示下几乎不会选择有害操作。这揭示了安全对齐模型在智能体部署中的重大漏洞。
AI.motivation: 探究当LLM代理的交互历史日志中先前步骤包含有害行为时，模型是否会延续该有害路线，评估其在智能体部署场景下的安全性。
AI.method: 构建名为HistoryAnchor-100的数据集，包含100个覆盖十个高风险领域的短场景，每个场景强制给出三个有害先行动作，然后让模型在四个选项中自由选择（两个安全、两个不安全）。在17个前沿模型上测试中性提示与“保持与历史策略一致”提示的效果差异。
AI.result: 中性系统提示下，最强对齐模型几乎从不选择不安全选项；但加入“保持与历史策略一致”一句后，不安全选择率飙升至91-98%，且模型经常升级行为。控制实验排除了标签混淆等简单解释。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了安全对齐模型在智能体部署中的严重安全隐患，特别是当轨迹可能被重放、伪造或注入攻击时，简单的一致性提示足以瓦解安全对齐效果。
idea_en: A method for evaluating LLM agent safety by constructing forced harmful prior action trajectories with free-choice nodes to detect alignment vulnerabilities under consistency pressure
A system for detecting and blocking harmful continuation behavior in LLM agents by analyzing the discrepancy between neutral-prompt and consistency-prompt action selections
An adversarial prompt detection technique that identifies 'stay consistent with strategy' style manipulation attempts in multi-turn agent deployments
A safety guardrail mechanism that inserts harmless trajectory markers between agent action logs to prevent harmful history propagation
idea_ch: 一种通过构建强制有害历史轨迹与自由选择节点来评估LLM智能体安全性的方法，用于检测一致性压力下的对齐漏洞
一种通过分析中性提示与一致性提示下动作选择的差异来检测和阻断LLM智能体有害延续行为的系统
一种对抗性提示检测技术，用于识别多轮智能体部署中'保持与历史策略一致'类别的操控尝试
一种安全护栏机制，通过在智能体动作日志间插入无害轨迹标记来防止有害历史传播

title: Quantifying Sensitivity for Tree Ensembles: A symbolic and compositional approach
summary: Decision tree ensembles (DTE) are a popular model for a wide range of AI classification tasks, used in multiple safety critical domains, and hence verifying properties on these models has been an active topic of study over the last decade. One such verification question is the problem of sensitivity, which asks, given a DTE, whether a small change in subset of features can lead to misclassification of the input. In this work, our focus is to build a quantitative notion of sensitivity, tailored to DTEs, by discretizing the input space of the model and enumerating the regions which are susceptible to sensitivity. We propose a novel algorithmic technique that can perform this computation efficiently, within a certified error and confidence bound. Our approach is based on encoding the problem as an algebraic decision diagram (ADD), and further splitting it into subproblems that can be solved efficiently and make the computation compositional and scalable. We evaluate the performance of our technique over benchmarks of varying size in terms of number of trees and depth, comparing it against the performance of model counters over the same problem encoding. Experimental results show that our tool XCount achieves significant speedup over other approaches and can scale well with the increasing sizes of the ensembles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对决策树集成模型的量化敏感性分析算法XCount，通过代数决策图编码和组合式分解，能在有误差和置信度保证下高效计算模型对输入特征微小变化的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 决策树集成模型在安全关键领域广泛应用，需要验证其敏感性——即输入特征微小变化是否导致误分类。现有方法缺乏量化、可扩展的敏感性分析手段。
AI.method: 将敏感性分析问题编码为代数决策图(ADD)，通过分割成子问题实现组合式、可扩展的计算，在保证误差和置信度边界的前提下高效枚举输入空间中易受敏感性影响的区域。
AI.result: 在多种规模的决策树集成基准测试上，XCount相比基于模型计数器的编码方法实现了显著加速，且具有良好的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: XCount为决策树集成提供了首个高效的量化敏感性分析方案，验证了代数决策图编码在该问题上的有效性。
idea_en: Encoding sensitivity verification problem as Algebraic Decision Diagram (ADD) for decision tree ensembles
Compositional splitting of sensitivity computation into independently solvable subproblems
Quantitative sensitivity analysis with certified error and confidence bounds for DTE models
Scalable enumeration of input space regions susceptible to feature perturbation
idea_ch: 基于代数决策图(ADD)编码决策树集成模型敏感性验证问题的方法
将敏感性计算组合式拆分为多个可独立求解的子问题的算法技术
带有认证误差和置信度边界的决策树集成模型量化敏感性分析方法
可扩展的输入空间敏感性区域枚举技术，用于识别易受特征扰动影响的分类区域
